title: Lead Application Specialist - General Imaging
description:
**Job Description Summary**
As the Lead Application Specialist for Ultrasound, you will be responsible for driving and executing clinical education training, demonstration management, and demonstration strategies. You will facilitate evidence-based practices and support both the customer experience and commercial teams from pre-sale through post-implementation by delivering effective, outcome-based education and training solutions. Your efforts will directly impact our customers’ ability to enhance productivity, improve patient care, and elevate quality by optimizing their technical and clinical competencies, image quality, workflow, and protocol management.
  
  
GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Provide technical and clinical leadership during the sales process by demonstrating the full range of Ultrasound products, including potential uses, product capabilities, and customer benefits.
* Coordinate, schedule, and execute objective-based system training for customers and channel partners; monitor and report on training outcomes.
* Develop and deliver product training to customers on equipment usage.
* Monitor customer installations of ultrasound products within the assigned territory/region to enhance customer satisfaction and maintain strong relationships.
* Support trade shows and professional conferences by conducting product demonstrations and customer training sessions.
* Leverage market and product knowledge to assist the sales team in developing effective sales, marketing, and customer service strategies.
* Build and maintain relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) in the region; responsible for training the sales and dealer teams periodically to enhance their capabilities.
* Penetrate competitive accounts and provide current market intelligence to the business.
* Promote new product features (NPI) and clinical techniques; collaborate with customers to develop training plans and strategies that support new product adoption and ongoing training needs in Ultrasound.
* Serve as the focal point for the modality/team by identifying customer satisfaction issues, assisting with escalations, resolving problems, and addressing specialty training requests.
* Advocate for and support the adoption of hybrid training delivery models for customers.
* Maintain well-documented pre- and post-training records in alignment with global guidelines.
* Responsible for pre- and post-sales support of ultrasound systems. Responsibilities include conducting clinical activities such as workshops, CMEs, webinars, and hands-on training.
* The incumbent will be based as per requirement and will support the LCT (Local Customer Team) or the Region depending on the scope of priority.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree/ Diploma with 10+ years of experience in MNC as Ultrasound applications is required.
* Experience in Fetal Medicine, General Imaging, OB/GYN, Vascular Sonography, and Cardiology applications is essential
* Ultrasound technical/clinical industry experience is required, along with any applicable certifications.
* Good knowledge of 2D, Doppler, and color flow imaging, with experience in 3D and 4D imaging (especially for OB/GYN).
* Must be willing to travel up to 75%, both within and outside the assigned geographic region.

**Desired Characteristics**

* Excellent interpersonal, oral and written communication skills.
* Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs

**Inclusion and Diversity**
GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.
  
  
We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity.
  
  
Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

description:

**Job Description (Copy-Paste Text)**

**About SwitchON Foundation & Greenovation Accelerator**

SwitchON Foundation (est. 2008) is a mission-driven organization working to strengthen
**sustainable agriculture, rural livelihoods, and climate resilience**
. We partner with Farmer Producer Companies (FPCs), climate startups, investors, and institutions to build scalable solutions that create both economic and social impact.

The
**Greenovation Accelerator**
is our flagship platform for climate-focused startups, SMEs, FPOs, and FPCs working across agriculture, circularity, clean energy, resilience, and other areas of climate action. Through challenge programs, bootcamps, capacity building, mentorship, market linkages, and connections to capital, Greenovation helps promising organizations strengthen their business foundations and progress toward investment readiness and scale.

**Position Overview**

The
**Greenovation Accelerator Co-Lead**
will lead the end-to-end operational execution, capacity building, and ecosystem coordination for SwitchON’s flagship accelerator programs. Based in Kolkata or Bangalore (Hybrid), this role requires strong program management, field execution, deal flow sourcing, and startup engagement capabilities.

You will work directly with early-stage climate startups, Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), NGO partners, mentors, and internal teams to deliver high-impact bootcamps and foster founder communities. This role is highly execution-oriented and suited for an experienced professional who thrives in fast-moving, entrepreneurial, and impact-driven environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Program Execution & Operations:**

* Lead end-to-end operational execution and coordination of accelerator cohorts, challenges, webinars, and ecosystem engagements.
* Develop detailed implementation plans, operational workflows, timelines, and coordination systems for virtual and in-person programs.
* Plan, manage, and execute intensive 3-to-5-day bootcamps, immersive workshops, and pitch days across regional hubs.
* Track milestones, deliverables, participant attendance, and post-program growth trajectories.

**Startup, FPO & Ecosystem Deal Flow:**

* Drive multi-channel deal flow sourcing to identify high-quality climate tech startups, agri-tech innovators, and FPOs.
* Build long-term relationships with founders, eco-champions, FPOs, and grassroots innovators.
* Conduct regular startup check-ins, field visits, and on-ground ecosystem interactions.
* Handle application screening, due diligence support, eligibility evaluations, and panel logistics.

**Capacity Building & Founder Mentorship:**

* Design and deliver capacity-building workshops, bootcamps, and structured learning journeys tailored to startup and FPO needs.
* Identify capability gaps across cohorts and onboard relevant mentors, trainers, industry experts, and speakers.

**Investment & Startup Readiness Support:**

* Connect high-potential startups and FPOs directly with investment teams for catalytic grant and equity funding opportunities.
* Assist founders with startup readiness assessments, data room preparation, and pitch deck refinement.
* Support due diligence processes and investor review sessions.

**Community & Stakeholder Coordination:**

* Build and nurture a vibrant community network among cohort founders, alumni, mentors, and ecosystem enablers.
* Maintain program dashboards, trackers, and documentation to prepare clear progress updates for leadership and partners.

**Requirements & Qualifications**

* **Experience:**
  6+ years of hands-on experience managing startup accelerator programs, incubators, or venture-building initiatives.
* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Agriculture, Sustainability, Environmental Studies, or related fields (Master’s degree like MBA, MS, or MPP strongly preferred).
* **Track Record:**
  Proven ability in executing multi-day bootcamps, cohort capacity building, and deal flow sourcing across urban tech and rural/FPO ventures.
* **Operational Drive:**
  Skilled in managing multiple workflows, timelines, and stakeholders simultaneously with high discipline.
* **Field Readiness:**
  Comfortable with periodic field travel, site visits, and direct engagement with startup founders and rural collectives.
* **Language Proficiency:**
  Excellent written and verbal English communication; fluency in Hindi or regional languages preferred.

**Compensation & Perks**

* **Annual CTC:**
  ₹10.0 – ₹12.0 LPA per annum
* **Travel & Logistics:**
  All official travel, accommodation, and event logistics covered as per organizational policy.
* **Location:**
  Hybrid (Kolkata / Bangalore)

title: Quality Engineer 2
description:
**Job Description**
Develops test cases and simple test plans from requirements with minimal supervision. Maintains test environments, executes and maintains test suites, and conducts regression testing for assigned functionality. Documents and escalates results, reproduces customer-reported issues, and tracks defect resolution. Contributes to team coordination, updates documentation, and suggests process improvements. Implements basic automation under guidance and integrates tests into Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) workflows.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Test Design and Strategy:**

* Develops test cases from requirements and create basic test plans to support testing activities.
* Selects basic techniques to inform test execution within assigned scope.
* Reviews specifications for coverage within assigned scope to ensure test completeness.

**Test Execution:**

* Maintains test environments and assist with data management to support test execution.
* Executes and maintains test suites to validate assigned functionality.
* Documents and escalates results to the appropriate team members for resolution.
* Conducts basic regression testing to confirm defect resolution and ensure no unintended impacts.

**Defect Tracking and Management:**

* Reproduces and documents customer-reported issues, escalating as necessary to ensure resolution.
* Investigates and escalates defects to appropriate teams for resolution.
* Tracks and compiles defect data for assigned features, escalating notable trends or issues to leadership.
* Tracks resolution for features to confirm defects are addressed and retested as required.

**Collaboration and Communication:**

* Actively participates in regular project team meetings with minimal supervision, contributing input to support team objectives.
* Coordinates activities with other team members to align on testing needs and priorities.
* Maintains and updates testing tools under supervision to ensure readiness for use.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Provides documentation updates (e.g., instructions) with minimal supervision to ensure clarity and correctness.

**Automation:**

* Suggests improvements with informed functional knowledge to enhance testing processes and team efficiency.
* Develops simple test cases and implements automation for features under guidance to support test coverage.
* Debugs and maintains scripts to support defect resolution and ensure accurate test execution.
* Integrates tests into Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) workflows under supervision to support automated testing.

**Risk Assessment:**

* Assists in assessing risks and escalating issues as needed.
* Executes established quality gate procedures by reviewing test coverage reports and defect logs, flagging potential issues for more senior team members, and updating documentation under guidance.
* Supports test planning by reviewing plans for accuracy and identifying common impact areas, ensuring Scrum teams are informed and engaged in risk areas.

**Test Tooling:**

* Maintains and updates testing tools under supervision to ensure functionality and readiness for use.

**Core Responsibilities**
**Planning & Execution:**

* Tracks timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements. Prioritizes and adjusts work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance.

**Collaboration & Partnership:**

* Collaborates within team to better understand expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages a foundational understanding ofbusiness, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build partnerships with limited guidance. Actively listens and asks questions to enhance collaboration.

**Problem Solving:**

* Identifies and addresses issues, escalating problems to senior staff as needed in accordance with standard procedures. Compiles and reviews data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors.

**Continuous Learning:**

* Seeks opportunities to gain knowledge and learn new skills and/or tools aligned with industry trends and best practices. Utilizes feedback and training to improve skills. Participates in a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* I mplements updates to processes, protocols, and workflows to increase efficiency and effectiveness as directed with some guidance. Contributes to ideation for future process improvements.

description:

title: Climate Resilience and Adaptation Advisor
description:
****Opportunity Type:****
Regular Fixed Term (Fixed Term)
  
  
****Summary:****
Position Summary
  
  
The Climate Resilience Advisor provides technical and advisory support to strengthen climate resilience of Habitat for Humanity’s housing and settlement work across Asia Pacific programs. The Advisor will work with the Asia-Pacific regional team to support Country Offices. This will include the implementation of strategic guidance, provision of technical assistance, design and delivery of capacity strengthening, supporting research, evidence-based implementation and knowledge management, advocacy and partnership development. This will include coordination with HFHI Global Program Operations, and specifically the Director-Climate Resilience (e.g., on development and implementation of the Global Climate Approach). The Advisor will work to ensure the integration of climate adaptation and mitigation into housing and settlement work and community development initiatives.
  
  
The Advisor will serve as the regional focal point for climate action, and in this capacity will support Country Offices to understand climate risks, and options to address/mitigate these risks to reduce vulnerability and build resilience of low- and middle-income households and communities across the Asia Pacific region.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities:****
**Key Result Areas and Responsibilities**

* Strategic Alignment and Stakeholder Engagement (30%)

Provide technical thought leadership to ensure climate resilient housing and settlement programming is aligned with the Global Climate Approach, with contextualized implementation across Country Offices in Asia Pacific region.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****

* Provide technical leadership to support contextualized/localized implementation and monitoring of HFHI’s Global Climate Approach within the Asia Pacific region.
* Advise on current/recent sources of climate risk data and analyses, and options for integrating climate these risks into housing/settlement-focused project design, implementation and monitoring.
* Facilitate alignment and promote integration between climate resilience programming and broader disaster risk reduction/humanitarian programming.
* Serve as a technical resource and thought partner to Habitat Country Offices, supporting program design, implementation and learning.
* Engage with external stakeholders (HFHI’s global and regional partners, research institutions, NGOs, and networks) to strengthen technical positioning and partnerships opportunities around climate resilience and DRR.
* Represent HFHI and contribute to relevant regional and global forums, working groups, and coordination platforms, as required.
* Support strategic partnerships and collaboration opportunities that advance Habitat's climate resilience agenda.
* Capacity Building and Technical Support (25%)

Strengthen the technical capacity of Country Offices and partners to design, implement, and scale high-quality climate resilience housing/settlement programming
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
Assess in-country capacity, design and facilitate targeted capacity building initiatives (e.g., structured training, workshops, coaching) for National Organization staff on climate resilience.
  
  
Develop and maintain technical resources, tools, guidance documents, and learning materials.
  
  
Facilitate communities of practice, peer learning, and regional exchanges.
  
  
Promote organizational learning across countries, programs and operations.
  
  

* Technical Program Oversight (25%)

Provide advisory support to Country Offices to help ensure the quality of climate-related program design, implementation and monitoring. considerations into program designs, projects—supporting Country Offices to scale impact, and cross-learning across the Asia Pacific Region.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****

* Provide technical input and advisory support to Country Offices to strengthen integration of climate risk data/analyses and evidenced-based approaches into climate resilient housing/settlements project design, implementation and monitoring.
* Advise Country Offices on context specific adaptation measures, including resilient construction techniques, site selection, safer land use, and community-based approaches.
* Where feasible, advise Country Offices on context appropriate mitigation measures, where feasible,
* Contribute technical input to concept notes, program proposals, and donor reports related to climate resilience (e.g., adaptation and mitigation).
* As requested, support donor engagement resource mobilization efforts.
* Collaborate with other Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) and technical teams to ensure climate considerations are integrated into cross-sectoral programming.
* Research, Innovation, Learning and Knowledge Management (15%)

Strengthen evidence generation, cross-learning and innovation, to improve climate resilient housing/settlement programming and support scaling of effective approaches.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****

* Support research design and implementation, the generation and synthesis of evidence, and institutional learning specific to climate resilient housing.
* Document and share climate resilient housing/settlement promising practices, case studies, and lessons learned.
* Contribute to integration of climate and DRR indicators into MEAL systems and contribute to regional and global learning agendas.
* Contribute to research, support innovation pilots, and partnerships related to climate resilient housing and settlements.
* Develop and disseminate technical resources, and guidance materials.
* Provide subject matter expertise and technical advisory support to other departments and initiatives within HFHI.
* Disaster Preparedness, Response and Recovery Support (5%)

Provide advisory support to integrate climate risk reduction and resilience into disaster preparedness, response and recovery efforts
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
Work with the Housing Disaster Risk and Resilience (HDRR) team on climate risk reduction measures in response and recovery
  
  
Provide technical input on risk-informed approaches to recovery planning and implementation
  
  
Support alignment of recovery interventions with long-term resilience objectives
  
  
****Required Qualifications & Experience****

* Master’s degree in Climate Change, Environmental Sciences, Disaster Risk Reduction, Urban Planning, Engineering, Development Studies, or a related field
* Minimum 5–7 years of relevant experience in climate resilience, DRR, or risk-informed programming, preferably in the Asia-Pacific region
* Demonstrated experience supporting multi-country programs and working with decentralized teams
* Strong understanding of climate risks, adaptation, and resilience approaches in housing, settlements, or community development
* Strong understanding of climate risks, adaptation, resilience, and mitigation approaches in housing, settlements, infrastructure, or community development.
* Experience in humanitarian, recovery, or nexus programming is an asset
* Experience in donor engagement, proposal development, or climate finance is an advantage

****Key Skills & Competencies****

* Strong technical expertise in climate adaptation and the built environment
* Sound understanding of climate mitigation, with the ability to understand where synergies and tradeoffs exist between mitigation and adaptation (especially where these impact affordability)
* Ability to translate technical concepts into practical, field-oriented guidance
* Proven advisory, facilitation, and capacity-building skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English (regional languages an asset)
* Strong cross-cultural collaboration skills and ability to work in matrixed environments
* Willingness and ability to travel within the Asia-Pacific region

**Core Behavioral Competencies**

* Commitment to HFHI’s mission, values, equity, and safeguarding principles
* Collaboration and partnership mindset
* Learning oriented and solution focused
* Accountability and integrity

**Working Conditions**

* Regional role with frequent collaboration across multiple countries and time zones.
* Periodic travel to Country Offices and Country Offices, including fragile, climate-vulnerable, and disaster-affected contexts.
* Ability and willingness to travel within the Asia-Pacific region as required.

****About Us:****
Habitat for Humanity, founded in 1976, is a global, Christian-based nonprofit organization that grew out of an intentionally multi-racial community in rural Georgia. Seeking to put God’s love into action, Habitat brings together people of all faiths and people of no faith to build homes, communities and hope. Working alongside each other, we help families and individuals build and improve places to call home and achieve the strength, stability and self-reliance they need to build better lives for themselves. Habitat seeks individuals who have a willingness to affirm these principles and values.
  
  
At Habitat for Humanity International, we are compelled by our Koinonia roots to put God’s love for all into action and pursue housing equity and opportunity by bringing all people together to build community and drive impact. We strive to build a culture rooted in learning, accountability and trust, attracting and retaining mission-driven talent reflective of the global communities we serve.
  
  
****Equal Opportunity Employer Statement:****
As an equal opportunity employer, we realize our success depends on courageously committing to being a workplace where all staff feel safe, welcome, visible, respected, supported and valued, and building a workforce that reflects a variety of lived experiences, backgrounds and perspectives, in which every person experiences dignity and respect.

title: Associate Director- Protection & Control
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
Jacobs is a global provider of technical, professional, and scientific services including engineering, architecture, construction, operations, and project management. Our portfolio spans industrial, commercial, and government clients across multiple markets and geographies. We have a PAN-India presence, with world-class engineering delivery centres in Mumbai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Pune, Chennai and Kolkata.
  
  
Challenging Today…Reinventing Tomorrow.
  
  
Jacobs is seeking a
**Associate Director- Protection & Control**
to support a range of high-profile projects across our Power & Energy portfolio. In this role, you will serve as a global Subject Matter Expert – Protection & Control, IEC 61850 & Digital Substations providing advanced technical leadership for protection and control engineering across substations, transmission and distribution systems, renewable interconnections, industrial power networks and digital grid infrastructure.
  
  
The SME will act as a technical authority for conventional, hybrid and fully digital substations, supporting projects across global markets including UK, Australia, Middle East, Europe, North America and Asia-Pacific. The role requires deep domain expertise in protection schemes, relay settings, substation automation, IEC 61850 integration, SCADA interfaces, cybersecurity, commissioning support and future-ready digital substation technologies.
  
  
**The Primary Responsibilities Would Be**
**Protection & Control Engineering**

* Provide specialist technical leadership for protection and control design of medium voltage, high voltage and extra high voltage substations.
* Lead, review and technically assure protection schemes for

+ Line protection
+ Transformer protection
+ Busbar protection
+ Breaker failure protection
+ Feeder protection
+ Capacitor bank and reactor protection
+ SVC / STATCOM protection
+ Renewable and BESS interconnection protection
+ Industrial power network protection
+ Grid connection and interconnection protection

* Lead and review key engineering deliverables including

+ Protection Single Line Diagrams / Key Line Diagrams
+ Protection and control schematics
+ Control logic diagrams
+ Trip and alarm matrix
+ AC/DC auxiliary schematics
+ Panel GA and BOQ
+ Wiring diagrams
+ Interface drawings
+ Interconnection schedules
+ Cable schedules
+ Relay assembled forms
+ Test and commissioning documentation

* Provide expert review of relay setting calculations and protection coordination studies.
* Review and approve relay settings, protection philosophies, technical reports and protection coordination documents.
* Provide technical direction for distance protection, differential protection, overcurrent protection, earth fault protection, REF, synchro-check, auto-reclose, breaker failure and busbar protection applications.
* Support fault level studies, protection grading, grid code compliance and system performance validation.
* Provide technical support during FAT, SAT, commissioning, energization and post-energization troubleshooting.
* Review vendor drawings, relay configuration files, test procedures, test reports and as-built documentation.

**IEC 61850 Integration and Digital Substations**

* Lead advanced engineering for IEC 61850-based digital substations, including concept design, detailed design, configuration strategy, integration, testing and commissioning support.
* Define and review complete digital substation architecture including

+ Station bus
+ Process bus
+ Protection IEDs
+ Merging units
+ SCADA gateways
+ HMI systems
+ Engineering workstations
+ Network switches
+ Time synchronization systems

* Provide expert guidance on IEC 61850 applications including

+ GOOSE messaging
+ MMS communication
+ Sampled Values
+ Logical nodes and data modelling
+ Dataset configuration
+ Report control blocks
+ GOOSE control blocks
+ Sampled Value control blocks
+ Multi-vendor interoperability

* Lead preparation and review of IEC 61850 deliverables including

+ IEC 61850 architecture drawings
+ Communication architecture
+ IED capability assessment
+ Signal lists and data point schedules
+ GOOSE mapping schedules
+ MMS mapping schedules
+ Sampled Value design documents
+ Logical node mapping
+ ICD, CID, IID, SCD and SSD file review records
+ FAT/SAT procedures for IEC 61850 systems

* Provide expert review and validation of IEC 61850 configuration files and ensure consistency between drawings, relay configuration, automation configuration and SCADA mapping.
* Lead or support multi-vendor integration involving Siemens, Hitachi Energy / ABB, GE Vernova, Schneider Electric, SEL, NR Electric and other global OEMs.
* Support digital substation testing using tools such as Omicron, Doble, Wireshark, IEDScout, StationScout, IET600, DIGSI 5, PCM600, EnerVista and equivalent platforms.
* Guide project teams on migration from conventional hardwired systems to hybrid or fully digital substation architecture.
* Develop digital substation templates, standard architectures, reusable design libraries and configuration governance processes.

**Substation Automation, SCADA and Communication Networks**

* Provide technical leadership for substation automation systems, SCADA integration, RTU/Gateway interfaces, HMI systems and control centre communication.
* Review communication protocols and interfaces including IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-101/104, IEC 60870-5-103, DNP3, Modbus, OPC UA, SNMP and synchrophasor interfaces where applicable.
* Lead design and review of digital substation communication networks including

+ Ethernet LAN architecture
+ Managed switch configuration philosophy
+ VLANs and IP addressing
+ Multicast management
+ PRP / HSR redundancy
+ Network segmentation
+ Remote engineering access
+ Network monitoring and diagnostics

* Provide guidance on time synchronization systems including IEEE 1588 PTP, SNTP, IRIG-B and GPS-based time sources.
* Review communication architecture for high availability, resilience and reliable operation of critical protection and control systems.

**Cybersecurity Considerations**

* Provide technical leadership on cybersecurity requirements for protection, control, automation and digital substation systems.
* Ensure cybersecurity is embedded across the engineering lifecycle from concept design through commissioning and handover.
* Review designs against relevant cybersecurity standards and requirements such as IEC 62351, IEC 62443, NERC CIP where applicable, utility standards and client-specific cybersecurity requirements.
* Provide guidance on secure substation architecture including

+ Network segmentation
+ Defense-in-depth design
+ Secure remote access
+ Role-based access control
+ User authentication
+ Password and credential management
+ Firewall and gateway interface requirements
+ Secure engineering access
+ Logging and event monitoring
+ Asset inventory
+ Patch and firmware management considerations
+ Backup and recovery strategy
+ Configuration file control
+ IED, gateway, HMI and workstation hardening

* Define cybersecurity requirements for vendors and OEMs during specification, procurement, FAT, SAT and commissioning stages.
* Support cybersecurity risk reviews for IEC 61850 systems, SCADA links, remote access, vendor interfaces and third-party equipment.
* Promote secure-by-design principles for digital substations, renewable plants and future grid automation systems.

**Renewable Energy, Grid Connection And Future Capabilities**

* Provide SME support for solar, wind, battery energy storage, hybrid renewable plants, collector substations and grid interconnection facilities.
* Support protection design for inverter-based resources, weak grids, low fault current networks and changing grid behaviour.
* Provide technical guidance on grid code compliance for renewable interconnections across different countries and regions.
* Support future capability development in

+ Digital substations
+ Process bus implementation
+ Centralized protection systems
+ Virtual protection and control concepts
+ Wide Area Monitoring, Protection and Control
+ Synchrophasor-based applications
+ Digital twin for substations
+ Model-based engineering
+ Automated relay setting workflows
+ AI-assisted engineering checks
+ Cloud-based asset monitoring
+ Predictive maintenance
+ Cyber-secure remote commissioning
+ Standardized global digital substation delivery models

**Technical Assurance, Quality and Delivery**

* Act as the highest level of technical support for complex protection, control, automation and digital substation issues.
* Provide independent technical review, design assurance and quality validation for critical deliverables.
* Ensure engineering outputs comply with client specifications, utility standards, grid codes, IEC, IEEE, CIGRE recommendations, regional requirements and Jacobs quality procedures.
* Support project execution plans, design criteria, risk registers, assurance plans and quality review processes.
* Support resolution of client queries, technical deviations, design changes, non-conformances and site issues.
* Work with Design Project Engineers, Project Managers and global delivery teams to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget and to expected quality standards.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of technical, commercial, schedule, risk, HSEC and quality aspects of projects.

**Client, Proposal and Capability Development**

* Lead technical discussions with clients, utilities, OEMs, contractors and global project teams.
* Support proposals, bids, tenders, technical estimates, capability statements and technical bid evaluations.
* Manage technical relationships and build appropriate level contacts with key clients.
* Strengthen client relationships through technical excellence, practical problem solving and high-quality project delivery.
* Mentor Lead Engineers, Senior Engineers, Graduate Engineers and design teams.
* Develop internal capability through training, technical sessions, lessons learned and knowledge sharing.
* Create and maintain technical standards, design guides, checklists, templates, automation workflows and best-practice documents.
* Drive innovation, digital delivery, standardization and future-ready engineering practices across the Protection & Control discipline.

Here's what you'll need
  
  

* BE / B Tech / ME / M Tech in Electrical Engineering.
* Minimum 18+ years of experience in Protection & Control engineering, substation automation, digital substations or associated power system engineering.
* Strong experience in MV, HV and EHV substation protection and control systems.
* Experience with substations up to 400kV / 765kV and above is desirable.
* Proven experience supporting international utility, renewable, industrial and grid connection projects.
* Expert knowledge of protection philosophies, relay applications, control systems, SCADA integration, substation automation and digital substation technologies.
* Strong experience in IEC 61850 design, configuration review, integration, testing and troubleshooting.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity requirements for protection, automation and digital substation systems.
* Ability to interpret international standards, utility requirements, client specifications and grid codes.
* Excellent technical report writing, communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to act as a global technical authority, mentor teams and support capability growth across the business.

**Mandatory Skill Sets**

* Expert-level knowledge of Protection & Control engineering for substations, T&D systems, renewable interconnections and industrial power networks.
* Strong knowledge of protection schemes, relay setting calculations, relay configuration, protection coordination and testing.
* Advanced knowledge of IEC 61850 including station bus, process bus, GOOSE, MMS, Sampled Values, logical nodes, datasets, control blocks and SCD file management.
* Strong understanding of digital substation architecture, IED integration, communication networks and multi-vendor interoperability.
* Strong awareness of cybersecurity standards and secure-by-design principles.
* Strong technical assurance, quality review and independent design checking capability.
* Ability to lead complex technical discussions with clients, utilities, OEMs and global project teams.
* Experience supporting FAT, SAT, commissioning and troubleshooting of protection, control and digital substation systems.
* Strong communication and presentation skills to articulate clear technical direction.

**Preferred Skill Sets**

* Experience with tools such as DIGSI 5, PCM600, EnerVista, Easergy Studio, AcSELerator, IET600, Omicron Test Universe, StationScout, IEDScout, Doble and Wireshark.
* Experience with AutoCAD, AutoCAD Electrical, MicroStation, ETAP, DIgSILENT PowerFactory, PSCAD or PSS/E.
* Experience in Australia, UK, Middle East, Europe, US or other international utility projects.
* Experience in solar, wind, BESS, hybrid renewable plants and grid interconnection projects.
* Experience with IEC 62351, IEC 62443, NERC CIP or utility cybersecurity frameworks.
* Knowledge of PRP, HSR, VLANs, multicast traffic management, PTP, SNTP, IRIG-B and network resilience requirements.
* Experience in model-based engineering, digital twin, automation workflows or data-centric engineering delivery.
* Basic understanding of Python or scripting for engineering process improvement is preferred.

**We welcome applications from qualified professionals currently based overseas who are open to relocating to India. Relocation support may be provided for exceptional candidates having extensive experience in
**delivering E&P infrastructure projects**
.**
At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

title: Technical Management Specialist
description:
Job Title: Technical Management Specialist
  
  
Req ID: 61872
  
  
Job Function: Engineering
  
  
Posting Start Date: 30/10/2026
  
  
Posting End Date: 04/11/2026
  
  
Division: BT International
  
  
Job Location: IND-Rajarhat-DLF IT
  
  
Advertised Salary: Competitive
  
  
**Job Req ID: 61872**
**Posting Date: 14-Aug-26**
**Function: Engineering**
**Location: Kolkata**
**Salary: Competitive**
**About The Role**
The LTE RAN RF Planning Engineer is reliable for monitoring, optimising, and maintaining the RF performance of a private LTE network and associated wireless technologies used to help mission critical mining operations. This includes ensuring consistent coverage, mobility, and capacity for self-governing haulage, fleet communications, IoT sensors, control systems, CCTV, rail operations, and Cambium point to multipoint (PTMP) / point to point (PTP) wireless links distributed across the mine.
  
  
The role focuses on operational RF optimisation, performance troubleshooting, and helping deployment or relocation of LTE cells and Cambium nodes in dynamic mining environments.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Manage incidents and requests while maintaining high ticket quality and hygiene.
* Develop RF propagation and coverage models for open-pit mine environments using tools such as HTZ, Atoll, Mentum, or similar.
* Perform advanced root cause analysis for LTE outages.
* Maintain and manage LTE macro/small cell hardware (FDD) suitable for dynamic mining operations.
* Perform frequency optimization, PCI/RSI planning, link budgets, interference analysis, and EARFCN/channel allocation.
* Create RAN capacity plans aligned with AHS (Autonomous Haulage System), telemetry, CCTV, and IoT demands.
* Provide remote guidance to field teams performing RF surveys, antenna alignment, and LTE trailer moves.
* Use TEMS Pocket / TEMS Discovery for drive test data analysis (onsite teams), RSRP/SINR profiling, Layer 3 message decoding, handover investigations, and KPI trend analysis.
* Analyse LTE RAN performance KPIs including throughput, PRB utilisation, accessibility, retainability, and mobility metrics.
* Identify and resolve issues such as overshooting, coverage holes, interference, and imbalance.
* Produce optimisation recommendations such as power adjustments, tilt optimisations, parameter changes, and azimuth
* Conduct remote troubleshooting sessions with onsite teams, providing step by step diagnostic guidance.
* Manage and optimise Cambium PTP/PTMP backhaul links using tools such as Cambium HTZ/ LINKPlanner.
* Perform path profile studies, Fresnel zone checks, and availability modelling.
* Provide remote alignment assistance and configuration guidance to site teams.
* Work with Mining Technology, AHS, Fleet Management, and OT Automation teams to understand coverage/performance needs, adjust designs for pit progression and mine expansion, and ensure stable connectivity for trucks, drills, shovels, LV, and IoT devices
* Provide remote RF design updates as mine topology changes
* Provide remote RF design updates as mine topology changes.
* Prepare RF design documents, coverage heatmaps, network design packs, BOMs, and commissioning documentation.
* Support acceptance and integration testing remotely.
* Maintain version-controlled RF documents and change logs.
* Design LTE and wireless systems for high reliability in remote industrial environments.
* Ensure designs comply with mining standards, cybersecurity requirements, and operational safety guidelines.
* Consider resilience, redundancy, and harsh environmental factors when developing plans.
* Manage and upkeep of NetAct server and software.

**Technical Skills Needed**

* Minimum 3–5+ years of LTE RAN planning, RF engineering, or optimisation experience.
* Experience with Private LTE / 5G SA networks in industrial deployments.
* Experience with common GIS applications eg: Global mapper,ArcGIS
* Knowledge of mining technologies (AHS, fleet management, dispatch systems).
* Networking knowledge: VLANs, routing, backhaul design, QoS.
* Scripting or automation (Python, SQL) for performance reporting is advantageous.
* Strong communication and coordination skills.

Rotational shifts of 24x7
  
  

* Preferred:
* LTE/RAN certification (nokia,Ericsson,Cisco)
* Cambium certification desirable
* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, or related field.

**Essential Skills / Experience**

* Strong understanding of LTE RAN concepts (EPC/E-UTRAN architecture, PCI planning, SINR/RSRP/TA, VoLTE, CA, etc.).
* Hands on experience analysing drive test data using TEMS Investigation or TEMS Discovery.
* Experience with RF planning tools (Atoll, HTZ, Planet, Mentum, iBwave).
* Experience with Cambium Networks (PTP 670/700, PMP 450i/450m,CnMaestro, cnWave, etc.).
* Strong analytical background in interpreting logs, KPIs, layer 3 messages, and RF statistics.
* Experience in ticketing-tools like Service Now, and exposure to ITIL processes in context of service operations is a plus.
* Experience supporting remote sites (mining/oil & gas/utilities) is preferred.
* Ability to work effectively with field teams from a remote location.

At BT International, our purpose is to keep the world connected. As part of BT, we build on almost 180 years of innovation and expertise to deliver secure connectivity and digital services to some of the world’s leading multinational businesses and organisations. Our customers trust us to safeguard their data, drive their digital transformation and keep their businesses running. With colleagues on the ground across the world and supporting customers wherever they need to operate, BT International offers a truly global experience. Whether it’s about providing cloud connectivity, helping organisations collaborate, or enabling innovation in cybersecurity and digital services, you’ll be part of a team that shapes how businesses succeed in a world that is being transformed by AI. If you have the drive and ambition to make an impact on a global stage, BT International is where it happens.

title: Fast-Manager
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
Job Description: Conversion SME (Manager)
  
  
**Position Title:**
Manager – Conversion Subject Matter Expert (Life Insurance & Annuities Policy Administration Transformation)
  
  
**Function:**
Insurance
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore / Chennai / Coimbatore / Kochi / Kolkata / Noida /Hyderabad / Pune / Trivandrum
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
The Conversion SME will own the end-to-end data and policy conversion strategy for a Life & Annuities policy administration system transformation (e.g., legacy platform to FAST/Majesco/OIPA/FINEOS target). This role bridges business, actuarial, and technical teams to ensure accurate, compliant, and auditable migration of in-force policy data, values, and transaction history from source to target systems.
  
  
Key Roles & Responsibilities
  
  
**Conversion Strategy & Governance**

* Define the end-to-end conversion approach: crosswalk methodology, data mapping standards, tolerance thresholds, and reconciliation framework between legacy and target platforms.
* Own the conversion playbook — cutover strategy (big-bang vs. phased/wave-based), fallback/rollback plans, and freeze-period governance.
* Establish data lineage documentation and version-controlled mapping specs for audit and regulatory traceability.

**Business & Technical Bridge**

* Translate legacy policy administration rules (billing, values, riders, beneficiaries, agent/commission structures) into target system configuration requirements.
* Partner with actuarial, IT, and QA teams to validate converted policy values (cash value, reserves, death benefit, surrender values) against source-of-truth calculations.
* Lead root-cause analysis on conversion breaks/exceptions and drive remediation with configuration or ETL teams.

**Data Mapping & Rules Definition**

* Author functional specifications for field-level, transaction-level, and history conversion (policy, billing, claims-in-progress, agent/commission, correspondence).
* Define exception handling rules for non-standard policies, riders, or legacy product variants that don't map cleanly to the target chart of accounts/product model.
* Validate mapping specs with source system SMEs and target platform configuration leads.

**Testing & Reconciliation**

* Design and oversee conversion test cycles (mock conversions, parallel runs, dress rehearsals) and define pass/fail acceptance criteria.
* Own policy-level and aggregate-level reconciliation reporting (financial tie-outs, record counts, value tolerances) presented to governance/steering forums.
* Sign off on conversion readiness gates ahead of each cutover wave.

**Team & Stakeholder Management**

* Lead and mentor a pod of conversion analysts/testers (onshore/offshore); manage workload, quality, and delivery timelines.
* Act as primary conversion point of contact for client business owners, actuarial, compliance, and IT conversion teams.
* Present conversion status, risk, and exception dashboards to steering committee/PMO.

**Compliance & Risk**

* Ensure conversion approach aligns with regulatory requirements (state filings, policyholder notification rules, NAIC/IFRS 17 where applicable).
* Maintain audit trail documentation sufficient for internal audit and regulatory examination.

Must-Have Skills
  
  
**Category**
**Requirement**
**Domain**
9
  
  
**Platform**
Hands-on conversion experience on at least one target PAS: FAST, Majesco, OIPA, FINEOS, or equivalent legacy modernization platform
  
  
**Conversion-specific**
Prior experience in at least one full PAS conversion/migration cycle — mapping, mock conversions, parallel testing, cutover
  
  
**Data**
Strong SQL skills; experience with data mapping/ETL concepts; policy value reconciliation (cash value, reserves, COI, fund values for annuities)
  
  
**Documentation**
Ability to write field-level functional specs, mapping documents, and test scripts to consulting-grade standards
  
  
**Delivery**
Experience managing a pod, sprint/wave-based delivery, and reporting into a governance/PMO structure
  
  
**Regulatory**
Familiarity with state insurance regulations, policyholder notification requirements, and IFRS 17/statutory reporting impacts on conversion
  
  
**Preferred Skills**

* Prior Big 4/IT Service Company or systems integrator consulting background
* Experience with both Life and Annuities product lines (not just one)
* Exposure to agile delivery frameworks (Scrum/SAFe) in a conversion pod context
* Group Benefits conversion exposure (cross-domain flexibility)
* Vendor-side experience (e.g., having worked at a FAST/Majesco/FINEOS implementation partner)

**Credentials/Certifications (Preferred, Not Mandatory)**

* LOMA certifications relevant to conversion/operations
* CSPO® / PMP® / Prosci (change management) for delivery-side credibility
* Platform-specific certifications (FAST, Majesco, FINEOS) where available

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
  
  
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

**Application Engineer**
part of the Customer Success team in India, you will support our valued customers across our Lab informatics product solutions. **analytical skills, and**
you are
**eager to learn**
about new software technology, instruments, applications, and consumables. You have
**communication/interpersonal skills**

and
**autonomously**
.

title: Enterprise Platform Advisor
description:
**Project Role :**
Enterprise Platform Advisor
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Provide consulting services and advice on complex enterprise transformations involving one or more technology platforms. Advise on platform selection, technology cost optimization and/or value levers. Develop and implement market-leading industry- and/or function-specific technology assets.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Change Management
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 2 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
Change Management – Analyst
  
  
Summary: As a Change Management Analyst, you will support clients through the organizational, cultural and workforce shifts that come with large platform-led transformation. You will work as part of a change workstream on a live client programme - running stakeholder and change impact analysis, building communications and learning assets, tracking readiness and adoption, and helping business teams get ready for new ways of working.
  
  
You will be expected to deliver your own tasks independently, with guidance from a consultant or Change Lead, and to grow steadily into a subject matter expert in one or more change capabilities. This role offers strong consulting foundations, industry exposure and hands-on experience with AI-enabled change accelerators.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:-
  
  
Change strategy, impact and readiness
  
  
Conduct stakeholder analysis and maintain stakeholder maps, engagement plans and RACI views for assigned business units or geographies.
  
  
Run change impact assessments - capture process, system, role and behaviour changes, and translate them into practical mitigation actions.
  
  
Support business readiness tracking through readiness criteria, checklists, surveys and pulse checks ahead of each deployment wave.
  
  
Contribute to change strategy documents, change plans, case-for-change narratives and leadership alignment material.
  
  
Communications and engagement
  
  
Draft and produce change communications - emails, newsletters, intranet and Viva Engage posts, FAQs, leadership messages, posters and videos - aligned to the approved communication plan and client brand.
  
  
Maintain the communications calendar, manage approvals and track distribution and reach.
  
  
Support change champion and super-user networks: onboarding material, toolkits, forums, recognition and feedback loops.
  
  
Help plan and run engagement moments such as town halls, roadshows, demo days, floor walks and adoption campaigns.
  
  
Learning and enablement
  
  
Support training needs analysis and role-to-course mapping for impacted user groups.
  
  
Develop end-user enablement assets - job aids, quick reference cards, e-learning storyboards, simulations, how-to videos and instructor decks.
  
  
Coordinate training logistics, LMS uploads, attendance tracking, train-the-trainer sessions and post-training feedback.
  
  
Support hyper care and floor-walking activity around go-live and capture recurring user issues for resolution.
  
  
Adoption, analytics and AI accelerators
  
  
Use generative AI, agentic AI and other change accelerators to improve the speed, quality and personalization of change deliverables.
  
  
Track readiness, adoption, sentiment and proficiency metrics using digital adoption platforms, usage telemetry and survey tools.
  
  
Build and refresh adoption dashboards and status reports highlight trends, risk areas and recommended interventions.
  
  
Support value measurement by linking adoption data to programme benefits and business outcomes.
  
  
Delivery, governance and teaming
  
  
Own assigned deliverables end to end - quality, version control, client review cycles and on-time completion.
  
  
Maintain change trackers, RAID logs, governance packs and weekly or monthly status reporting for the change workstream.
  
  
Collaborate with business, functional, technical, deployment and PMO teams to keep change activity aligned to programme milestones.
  
  
Contribute to reusable assets, accelerators, templates and internal knowledge sharing for the practice.
  
  
Professional & Technical Skills:
  
  
Must have
  
  
Core Change Management
  
  
Change Impact & Business Readiness
  
  
Training & Learning Transformation
  
  
Change Communications & Engagement
  
  
Enterprise Platform Transformation exposure – SAP (including S/4HANA and SuccessFactors), Microsoft, Oracle, UKG or Workday
  
  
Strong written English, PowerPoint and Excel capability
  
  
Change PMO / Governance
  
  
Good to have
  
  
Agentic AI & AI Adoption (including Microsoft 365 Copilot enablement)
  
  
Change Analytics / Digital Adoption platforms (e.g. WalkMe, Viva Insights, Power BI)
  
  
PROSCI / APMG Change Management certification
  
  
Exposure to project management methodologies (Agile, waterfall, hybrid)
  
  
Creative design tools for communications, video and survey design
  
  
Additional Information:
  
  
Experience: 2-4 years of relevant change management experience
  
  
Locations: Bengaluru, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Noida
  
  
Education: 15 years of full-time education graduate degree or equivalent, MBA/PGDM preferred
  
  
Certification: PROSCI / APMG Change Management certification preferred
  
  
Mobility: May require mobility to client locations across India
  
  
Soft Skills required: Structured thinking, Communication, Storytelling, Collaboration, Adaptability, Ownership, Flexibility

you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.

+ Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, device and access related issues for local users.
+ Support new hire onboarding, workstation setup, user moves, and day to day break/fix activities.
+ Deliver timely user updates and ensure support activities are properly documented and managed through our approved ITSM processes.

* Workplace Technology & Site Support:

+ Support conference room and collaboration technology, including basic meeting room troubleshooting and readiness checks.
+ Assist with workstation setup, hot desk support, office moves, and shared workspace readiness.
+ Provide local smart hands assistance for infrastructure, network, telecom or vendor led onsite activities as required.
+ Coordinate with regional and global support teams to ensure smooth handling of issues requiring escalation.

* Device Lifecycle & Logistics:

+ Support deployment, provisioning, refresh, rebuild, recovery, and replacement of endpoint devices.
+ Assist with asset handling activities including receipt, setup, collection, return, and local coordination of hardware movements.
+ Support termination hardware retrieval, end of lease handling, and eWaste / recycling processes in alignment with company standards.
+ Maintain awareness of local inventory, device readiness, and support requirements for site.

* Operational Support & Continuous Improvement:

+ Perform first line diagnosis, troubleshooting, and resolution of onsite IT issues, escalating where needed.
+ Identify recurring issues and improvement opportunities affecting end user experience, support responsiveness or local site readiness.
+ Partner with Service Desk, Infrastructure Teams, and third party providers to help maintain stable service delivery.
+ Contribute to consistent support practices, documentation, and service quality across the local environment.

+ Demonstrate commitment to health, safety and compliance requirements applicable to the office or site environment.
+ Follow company processes for security, asset management, access, and technology handling.
+ Complete all required site or office inductions and work in accordance with local HSE expectations.

* Physical Demand/Work Environment:

+ The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to speak or listen. The employee frequently is required to walk and sit. The employee is occasionally required to stand. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Visual Acuity: must be adequate to perform all required Job Description tasks in a safe manner. The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet. Work is usually done in an office setting and sometimes at a client facility or job site.

**About You**
To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
  
  

* Required:

+ Experience in deskside, desktop, field, or end user support within a business environment.
+ Strong hands on troubleshooting skills across Windows endpoints, standard business applications, peripherals and user access issues.
+ Experience providing in person support to end users, including onboarding, break/fix, and workplace technology support.
+ Familiarity with IT Service Management tools such as ServiceNow.
+ Ability to work independently with limited supervision and manage multiple priorities.
+ Strong communication skills and a customer focused approach to support delivery.

* Preferred:

+ Experience supporting conference room, meeting room, or collaboration technologies.
+ Experience supporting mobile devices, including iOS and Android.
+ Familiarity with hardware lifecycle processes including provisioning, refresh, returns, and disposal coordination.
+ Experience providing smart hands support for network, service, or infrastructure related onsite activities.
+ Experience working in engineering, industrial, operational, or multi site business environments.

**Moving forward together**
We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
  
  
And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

* Provides insights on whether solutions and technologies being implemented are meeting business requirements.
* Contributes to business case development and completes RFP responses, exploring and experimenting with new and existing data to tackle defined business problems.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Proven experience gathering and interpreting business requirements.
* Proven experience developing technical requirements and specifications, including knowledge of software engineering methodologies, reporting tools, modelling and testing.
* Proven understanding of Lean Six Sigma and Business Process Modelling and Notation.
* Knowledge on application building using Python would be an added advantage.

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Preferably CA/MBA/B.E/B.Tech with 8 to 10 years of implementation and advisory experience on Oracle Cloud ERP/EBS security and controls.
* Ability to drive risk and control programs for Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud, with a focus on the following:

+ Segregation of duty concerns in an ERP environment along with an ability to design SoD (Segregation of Duties) risk libraries, and preparation of remediation roadmaps.
+ System role-design, build security and troubleshoot security defects.
+ Design risk control matrices by conducting workshops with business process owners.
+ Review Oracle ERP IT Application Controls (ITAC) for test of design and test of effectiveness.
+ Identify potential opportunities to automate current ITDM/manual controls leveraging Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud.
+ Deep understanding of regulatory frameworks like COSO, COBIT.
+ Knowledge and audit experience across regulations like SOX, GDPR, CCPA.

* Functional knowledge on Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud Financials, Procurement, Supply chain management, Projects and HRMS is a pre-requisite.
* Sound relevant experience in either an internal or external business analysis role and/or software / technical analysis role or similar, evidenced by adding business value through identifying, analysing and articulating problems and solutions.
* Developed technical knowledge and experience in delivering IT solutions, providing technical advice and understanding user requirements.
* Some stakeholder management experience.
* Ability to simplify data and explain trends through Excel spreadsheets, dashboards, power-point presentations is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of Oracle GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) & Oracle Risk Management Cloud (RMC) is highly desirable.
* Working knowledge on Peoplesoft, NetSuite, MS Dynamics and Workday would be an added advantage.
* Willing to learn and work on different ERPs and CRM solutions

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment with consulting skills.
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1400 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. title: ERPNext Functional Expert & Implementation Specialist
description:
**Company Description**

Shree Rakhi is India’s largest manufacturer of Rakhis, dedicated year-round to supporting the festival of Raksha Bandhan. With over 70 years of experience, the company has been a consistent part of this cultural tradition, focusing on quality, variety, and wide accessibility. Shree Rakhi is recognized as India’s only Rakhi brand with reach across villages, towns, and cities nationwide. The organization combines heritage with modern operations, offering opportunities to contribute to a well-established, fast-moving consumer goods business.

**What We’re Looking For**

 

We are looking for an ERPNext Functional Expert & Implementation Specialist with 4–6 years of relevant experience to bridge the gap between our business operations and the technical development team. We are specifically looking for someone with a deep background in the
**manufacturing industry (especially high-volume manufacturing)**

who can analyze our shop-floor processes, design robust workflows, and translate those needs into clear, actionable Product Requirement Documents (PRDs).

This is a full-time leadership position for a strategic thinker who understands how a manufacturing business runs and knows how to map those operations flawlessly into ERPNext.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Business Analysis & PRD Creation:**

  Deeply understand our high-volume manufacturing operations, gather requirements from stakeholders, and write detailed, comprehensive Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) for the development team to execute.
* **Workflow & SOP Management:**

  Design, map, and optimize end-to-end business workflows. Develop, document, and enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across all departments (production, inventory, procurement, etc.) to ensure seamless ERP adoption.
* **Functional Solution Design:**

  Act as the architect for how ERPNext modules should be structured to solve our specific business challenges, ensuring standard out-of-the-box features are utilized effectively before requesting custom development.
* **Developer Liaison & Technical Product Management:**

  Act as the core bridge between the business stakeholders and the software developers. Prioritize the development backlog, explain business logic to coders, and guide the technical team on
  *what*

  needs to be built and
  *why*

  .
* **Testing & Quality Assurance:**

  Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate that the modules developed by the technical team perfectly match the PRDs and business requirements.
* **ERPNext Configuration:**

  Handle the functional configuration and master data setup within ERPNext (e.g., BOMs, Workstations, Routing, Item Groups, Chart of Accounts).
* **User Training & Support:**

  Create training materials and provide hands-on guidance to shop-floor staff and management on how to follow the newly established ERP workflows and SOPs.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:**

  Coordinate seamlessly with production, supply chain, and management teams to ensure the ERP system accurately reflects real-world manufacturing constraints and goals.

**Candidate Requirements**

* **Experience:**

  4–6 years of relevant experience in ERPNext functional consulting, business analysis, or technical product management.
* **Industry Knowledge:**

  Proven, extensive background in the
  **manufacturing industry**

  , with specific experience handling the complexities of
  **high-volume manufacturing**

  (production planning, inventory bottlenecks, supply chain logistics).
* **Product Management Skills:**

  Exceptional ability to write clear, structured PRDs, Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), and user stories.
* **Functional Expertise:**

  Deep understanding of standard ERPNext modules (Manufacturing, Buying, Selling, Stock, Accounting) and how they interact with one another.
* **Process Mapping:**

  Strong capability in designing business workflows, process flowcharts, and implementing SOPs.
* **Analytical Skills:**

  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to foresee business edge-cases and incorporate them into system designs.
* **Soft Skills:**

  Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Must be able to speak the language of both business operators and technical developers.
* **Execution-Oriented:**

  A hands-on, structured approach to managing product timelines and ensuring development matches business goals.

**Added Advantage (Nice to Have)**

* **AI for Productivity & Coding:**

  Ability to use AI coding assistants (such as
  **Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or similar tools**

  ) to generate code snippets, prototype modules, or accelerate the development team's execution is a major plus.

**What We Value**

﻿
We value people who build trust through integrity, earn loyalty through consistency, and take ownership with a bias for action. Someone who is curious, patient, adaptable, and eager to learn, works as a team player, uses technology intelligently, and has the stability and genuine intent to grow with the organization.

title: Food Technologist
description:
**Company Description**
Spoonfool is a cereal-focused food company committed to making high-quality, great-tasting breakfast products. The team combines food science, sensory expertise, and careful ingredient selection to deliver cereals that meet modern consumer expectations for flavor, texture, and consistency. The company emphasizes innovation in recipes and production methods to continuously improve its product range. Spoonfool offers an environment where food professionals can contribute to product development that reaches a broad consumer base. Team members collaborate closely across functions to turn cereal concepts into reliable products on store shelves.
  
**Role Description**
The Food Technologist at Spoonfool will support the development, testing, and improvement of cereal products from concept to scale-up. Day-to-day responsibilities include conducting sensory evaluations, performing laboratory analyses, and collaborating with R&D to optimize formulations and processing conditions. The role involves monitoring quality control parameters, documenting test results, and ensuring that products meet safety and regulatory standards. The Food Technologist will work closely with production teams to troubleshoot issues, validate process changes, and help maintain consistent product quality. This is a contract position and a hybrid role based in the Kolkata metropolitan area, with regular on-site work at facilities and some work-from-home flexibility for documentation, data analysis, and planning tasks.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in Food Technology and cereal product development.
* Hands-on Laboratory Skills, including sample preparation, analytical testing, and data recording.
* Experience with Sensory Evaluation methods and panel coordination.
* Knowledge of Quality Control processes for food manufacturing and familiarity with safety and regulatory standards.
* Background in Research and Development (R&D), including formulation trials and process optimization.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Food Technology, Food Science, or a related discipline.
* Ability to work effectively in a hybrid setup within the Kolkata metropolitan area, including time on the production floor.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and accurate documentation.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills for cross-functional work with R&D, quality, and production teams.
* Experience in cereal or grain-based products is an advantage.
