title: Tender Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
SINHOP ENGINEERING CONSULTANTS PRIVATE LIMITED is an engineering consultancy firm headquartered in Kolkata, West Bengal, India. The registered office is located at Unit 3 B Girindra Cooperative Housing Society Limited,Prantik Pally Kasba, Kolkata – 700107. The company provides professional engineering and consulting services to a range of clients, with an emphasis on quality, reliability, and technical expertise. SINHOP maintains accessible communication channels through its office contact number and dedicated email, supporting responsive client service and project coordination. The organization offers opportunities for engineering professionals to work on diverse projects in a structured and collaborative environment.
  
**Role Description**
The Tender Engineer is responsible for managing the end-to-end tendering process for engineering and consultancy projects in an on-site, full-time role based in Kolkata. Day-to-day responsibilities include identifying relevant tenders, reviewing tender documents and technical specifications, and coordinating with internal teams to gather technical, commercial, and legal inputs. The role involves preparing comprehensive bid proposals, cost estimates, BOQs, and supporting documentation, while ensuring compliance with client requirements and applicable standards. The Tender Engineer will track submission deadlines, participate in pre-bid meetings and clarifications, and support post-submission follow-ups, negotiations, and documentation. The position also includes maintaining tender databases, updating management on tender status, and contributing to process improvements for efficient bid management.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong technical background in engineering (civil, mechanical, electrical, or related discipline) with the ability to understand drawings, specifications, and project scopes.
* Experience in tendering, bid preparation, estimation, and costing for engineering or infrastructure projects.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and familiarity with estimation or tender management software tools.
* Solid understanding of contract terms, procurement processes, and regulatory or compliance requirements relevant to engineering tenders.
* Effective communication, documentation, and presentation skills, with the ability to coordinate inputs from cross-functional teams.
* Strong analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and accuracy in calculations and proposals.
* Ability to work on-site in Kolkata, manage multiple tenders simultaneously, and meet strict deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Engineering or a related field; prior experience in a tendering or proposals role will be considered an advantage.

title: BCM-FINACLE-Techno Functional-Senior-GDSF02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Consulting – Banking & Capital Markets: Finacle Core Banking**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
This document covers two role profiles for Finacle Core Banking transformation programs: Techno-Functional Consultant – Manager and Business Analyst – Senior.
  
  
**Role Profile: Business Analyst – Senior**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a functional and techno-functional Business Analyst with prior experience in Infosys Finacle Core Banking. The role focuses on requirements management, solution mapping, process modelling, data analysis, integration and API requirements, interface specifications, and banking data structures across Finacle implementation, transformation, migration, upgrade and modernization programs.
  
  
**Role Business Analyst – Finacle Core Banking**
**Experience 5+ years in banking; 3+ years in business analysis**
**Domain Retail and Corporate Banking, Lending, Payments and Cards, Compliance, Treasury, Investment Banking and Wealth Management**
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Work as a Business Analyst in banking transformation projects.
* Conduct requirements workshops and stakeholder discussions with business and technology teams.
* Gather, analyze, document and validate business, functional and non-functional requirements.
* Prepare BRDs, FSDs, user stories, process flows, use cases, data mapping documents and test scenarios.
* Perform solution mapping and gap analysis between business requirements and Finacle capabilities.
* Coordinate with Solution Architecture, Development, Testing, Infrastructure and Vendor teams.
* Support data mapping, migration analysis, integration requirements and reconciliation activities.
* Ensure alignment among business requirements, solution design, testing activities and business objectives.
* Support SIT, UAT, Simulation, Go-Live and Hypercare from business and functional perspectives.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong understanding of Finacle Core Banking functionality and ecosystem, including parameterization and configuration impacts.
* Experience in requirements elicitation, business process modelling, functional design, fit-gap analysis and process transformation.
* Understanding of APIs, web services, interface specifications, integration touchpoints, banking data models and data mapping.
* Experience supporting data migration, reconciliation, validation, reporting, audit and regulatory data requirements.
* Exposure to digital and mobile banking, channel integrations, microservices, cloud, DevOps and modern banking technologies.
* Experience designing Java-based extensions, services and integration flows using Finacle Integrator and API Hub on Finacle 11x.
* Experience developing and customizing front-end interfaces, menus and client-side components for Finacle 11x.
* Strong knowledge of Retail Banking, Corporate Banking, Payments, Lending, Treasury, Liquidity, Finance, Risk, Compliance and regulatory processes.
* Client-facing communication, documentation, presentation, analytical and problem-solving skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* MBA, MCA, BE, BTech or equivalent qualification with banking industry experience.
* Business Analysis or banking domain certification such as CBAP, CCBA or ECBA.
* Experience with Agile, Scrum and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
* Exposure to Finacle Digital Banking, Payments, API Banking and Open Banking initiatives.
* Familiarity with SQL, reporting, reconciliation, UML, BPMN, Jira, Confluence or Azure DevOps.
* Experience using Generative AI and prompt engineering.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
Our Commitment
  
  
**As a commitment,**
we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How To Apply**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy. Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits. “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

candidate must have -

* Conduct Fit-Gap analysis between current operational workflows and standard SAP functionalities.
* Author detailed Functional Specifications (FS) for custom developments, reports, interfaces, and enhancements (RICEF objects).

SAP QM Core Configuration & Management
  
  

* Configure and maintain core SAP QM master data and functionalities, including:

+ Inspection Plans, Master Inspection Characteristics (MICs), Sampling Procedures, and Schemes.
+ Catalogs, Selected Sets, and Catalog Profiles.
+ Quality Info Records (QIRs) for Vendor Quality Management.

* Configure and support key QM operational workflows:

+ Quality Planning & Quality Inspection (Incoming, In-Process, and Final Inspections).
+ Results Recording, Defect Recording, and Usage Decisions (UD).
+ Quality Notifications, Root Cause Analysis, and Corrective Action workflows.
+ Quality Certificates creation and processing.

Module Integration & Traceability
  
  

* Ensure seamless cross-module integration between SAP QM and key supply chain/manufacturing modules:

+ Production Planning (PP): In-process inspection lots, routing integrations.
+ Materials Management (MM): Goods receipt inspections, vendor evaluation, stock transfers.
+ Sales & Distribution (SD): Delivery inspections, customer complaints, quality certificates.
+ Plant Maintenance (PM): Calibration inspections and equipment maintenance integration.
+ Extended Warehouse Management (EWM / WM): Warehouse inspection processes, inbound/outbound lot management.

* Oversee and configure Batch Management, including batch determination, classification, and end-to-end material traceability.

Implementation, Testing & Production Support
  
  

* Participate across all project phases: implementation, global rollouts, upgrades, and post-go-live support.
* Execute Unit Testing, Integration Testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Collaborate with ABAP development teams to build and test custom solutions, reports, and system interfaces.
* Provide incident management, ticket resolution, and root cause analysis within defined SLA timelines.
* Support system governance and project documentation using SAP Solution Manager / ALM.

Training & Documentation
  
  

* Develop detailed end-user documentation, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), business process charts, and training manuals.
* Conduct training sessions and knowledge-transfer workshops for business key users and end-users.
* Required Qualifications & Skills

Functional & Domain Expertise
  
  

* SAP QM Expertise: Proven experience in SAP QM module configuration, maintenance, and support across manufacturing or supply chain environments.
* Core Capabilities: In-depth knowledge of Inspection Types, Inspection Lots, Results Recording, Usage Decisions, Quality Notifications, Quality Certificates, Defect Management, and Quality Info Records.
* Master Data Management: Deep proficiency in Inspection Plans, MICs, Sampling Schemes, Catalogs, and Selected Sets.
* Traceability: Strong understanding of Batch Management, batch classification, and full forward/backward supply chain traceability.
* Domain Knowledge: solid understanding of core manufacturing quality management standards and supply chain operations.

Integration Knowledge
  
  

* Hands-on integration experience between SAP QM and:

+ SAP Production Planning (PP)
+ SAP Materials Management (MM)
+ SAP Sales & Distribution (SD)
+ SAP Plant Maintenance (PM)
+ SAP Extended Warehouse Management / Warehouse Management (EWM / WM)

* Exposure to SAP S/4HANA enterprise environments.

Technical & System Exposure
  
  

* Experience writing Functional Specifications (FS) and specifying requirements for RICEF objects.
* Hands-on experience with interface testing and debugging support alongside ABAP teams.
* Proficiency with SAP Solution Manager / Application Lifecycle Management (ALM).

Soft Skills & Competencies
  
  

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to bridge business and technical requirements.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting abilities.
* Demonstrated ability to manage deliverables within strict SLA timelines in production environments.
* Preferred Experience
* Participation in at least one full-lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementation or migration project.
* Experience in regulated manufacturing environments (e.g., Automotive, Life Sciences, Chemical, or Consumer Goods).

description:

: Microsoft 365 Support Engineer – L1

8 Resources

1–3 Years (Preferred)

Full-Time

We are looking for Microsoft 365 L1 Support Engineers to provide first-level technical support for Microsoft 365 applications and services. The ideal candidates should have basic knowledge of Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Microsoft Entra ID, and Microsoft Intune, along with strong troubleshooting, ticket management, and customer service skills.

* User and Access Management: Handle user account creation, password resets, license assignments, group management, and basic Microsoft Entra ID administration.
* Intune Support: Assist with device onboarding, enrollment, configuration, and basic Microsoft Intune-related issues.
* Outlook and Exchange Troubleshooting: Resolve basic Outlook connectivity, mailbox access, email delivery, and shared mailbox issues.
* Teams Support: Troubleshoot Microsoft Teams login issues, audio/video calling problems, and basic collaboration-related queries.
* SharePoint and OneDrive Support: Assist users with SharePoint access, OneDrive synchronization, file-sharing permissions, and basic application issues.
* Mailbox and Distribution List Management: Manage shared mailbox requests, distribution lists, and user access requests according to approved processes.
* Incident and Service Request Management: Log, track, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents and service requests within defined SLAs. Escalate complex issues to L2/L3 support teams.

* User Communication: Provide timely updates to end users, follow established support procedures, and ensure a positive user experience.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of experience in IT helpdesk, service desk, or Microsoft 365 support.
* Basic hands-on knowledge of Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive.
* Understanding of user account management, password resets, license assignment, and Microsoft Entra ID.
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Intune and device enrollment processes.
* Familiarity with Outlook troubleshooting, mailbox access, email delivery, and Teams connectivity issues.
* Experience using ticketing tools and working within SLA-driven support environments.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and customer service skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Knowledge of Active Directory fundamentals.
* Familiarity with ITIL processes and incident management.
* Microsoft 365 Fundamentals certification (MS-900) or equivalent knowledge.
* Experience working in a structured IT service desk or enterprise support environment.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
A customer-focused IT support professional capable of resolving routine Microsoft 365 issues, managing user access requests, documenting incidents accurately, and escalating complex technical problems to the appropriate support teams.

title: SAP FICA Functional-SENIOR
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Career Family: SAP Utilities**
**Role Type: Functional Consultant**
**The opportunity**
As part of our EY GDS-Utilities team, you will work to implement and support SAP IS-U projects for clients. You will get an opportunity to work with high quality team. You will get an opportunity to build innovating product which solves client’s problems.
  
  
We’re looking for Senior resources with expertise in
**SAP FI-CA**
to join the EYD GDS team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* To provide functional knowledge with hands-on experience in electricity, gas and water utilities.
* Hands on experience configuring the IS-U system
* Drive Business Workshops, Blueprint Sessions, develop BBPs/BBDs FS, Test Scenarios, conduct Trainings, perform Testing and provide defect management support for Device Management module
* Design core / customized business processes and provide best practices for ISU.
* Communicate complex requirements to and from Technical and Non-technical stakeholders
* Willing to travel as per requirement
* Monitors the progress and the quality of the project

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Should understand different business processes in the Utility Industry (Regulated and Deregulated)
* Should possess SAP FICA knowledge for preparation of business blueprints, business process plan (BPP), functional documents, and test cases etc.
* Should have knowledge of the Meter to Cash
* Should have experience in FICA Dunning procedure/Collection Strategy, payment (cash desk/external cash desk) integration with payment channels, write off, return processing, security deposit, installment plan, and promise to pay.
* Exposure of Country specific localization.
* Experience in BRIM CI FICA is good to have.
* Experience in configuring FICA Events and BRF+ (functional).
* Strong knowledge of clearing strategy, clearing rules.
* Experience in Cash Desk and clarifications.
* Strong knowledge of month-end and period-end closing and FICA to FICO GL integration.
* Experience in the de-regulated/Regulated energy market.
* Develop templates and methods to improve the efficiency of application support.
* Gather and prioritize relevant SAP Business requirements and designing the appropriate solution
* Understands configuration dependencies and inter-relationships between other modules of SAP such as Device Management, CS/CRM, Billing and design and troubleshoot in the area with this knowledge
* Define test scenarios to cover full scope of the business as well as creating master data and carry out the unit, cycle and integration tests
* Should be well versed to make enhancements in specific FICA events.
* Must have completed multiple SAP projects and have excellent communication skills
* Confidence working within an offshore/onshore delivery model
* Proven expedience large stream of work across multiple locations
* Consulting experience advantageous
* Strong hands-on experience on FI-CA concepts:

+ Company Code Setup
+ Chart of Accounts and GL setup
+ Main / Sub Transaction Setup
+ Security Deposit Process
+ Incoming Payments (Real Time, Direct Debit, Cash Desk, etc.)
+ Outgoing Payments and Returns
+ Collection process using Collection Strategy
+ Collection Agency related process
+ Transfer Posting process
+ Escheatment process

* Strong knowledge of month-end and period-end closing and FICA to FICO GL integration.
* Implementation experience of BRF Plus.
* Experience and knowledge of using middleware technology to integrate SAP with third party systems for payments, collection agencies, etc.
* Experience in data migration.
* Can work under minimum supervision, good time management and work planning

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* College degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences
* Approximately 5 to 8 years of experience in a functional role. Able to exhibit a progression of increasingly complex job responsibilities during the period
* Prior SAP BRIM CI role is a must
* Should have worked on minimum 1 implementation from scratch as a lead consultant.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience on integration with third-party applications
* Knowledge of integration with SAP RAR, BRIM CI/SOM/CM
* Hands on experience in SAP S4 HANA Platform
* Experience on tools like JIRA or equivalent tool to maintain stories.
* SAP Utilities certifications are a plus:

+ Certification in SAP FICA (IUT240 / AC240 / BR240)
+ Certifications in SAP BRIM Convergent Invoicing (AC245 / BR245)

**Technologies and Tools**

* SAP FI-CA / FI-CAX
* SAP FIORI
* Jira or similar tools
* Azure DevOps or similar tools

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Utilities practices globally with leading businesses across a range of geographies

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Tendering Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
operates in a dynamic, project-driven environment that requires careful planning, documentation, and coordination with multiple stakeholders. The organization focuses on delivering competitive, compliant proposals and tenders for a variety of contracts and clients. Team members are encouraged to take ownership of their work, maintain high professional standards, and contribute to process improvement. The work culture values reliability, attention to detail, and clear communication across functions to support successful bids and long-term partnerships.

The Tendering Specialist is a full-time, on-site role based in the Greater Kolkata Area. This role is responsible for managing the end-to-end tendering process GEM, EProcure, CPWD & Other State Tender portal, including identifying opportunities, analyzing tender requirements, preparing documentation, and submitting proposals within stipulated timelines. title: Senior Associate - Organizational Change Management
description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As a Senior Associate - Organizational Change Management, you will play a pivotal role in helping clients optimize their organizational structures and processes to enhance efficiency and effectiveness. Within our Management Consulting practice, you will focus on aligning organizational structures with strategic goals, driving long-term success for our clients. As a Senior Associate, you will leverage your skills to analyze complex problems, mentor junior team members, and maintain professional standards. You will build meaningful client relationships and develop a deeper understanding of the business context, navigating complex situations to grow your personal brand and deepen your technical skills.
  
  
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will deliver tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth. You will collaborate with subject matter experts to deliver training needs analysis, curriculum design, and blended training solutions, using industry-standard tools to create engaging learning assets. Your ability to adapt to changing priorities and work across time zones will validate seamless project execution and client satisfaction.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Designing and implementing learning solutions to support client transformation initiatives
* Collaborating with Subject Matter Experts to conduct Training Needs Analysis and develop curriculum
* Utilizing instructional design frameworks such as ADDIE and SAM to create engaging learning experiences
* Developing role-based learning plans and blended training solutions tailored to client needs
* Leveraging industry-standard authoring tools like Articulate Storyline and Adobe Captivate to create multimedia learning assets
* Publishing and managing content on Learning Management Systems, confirming accessibility standards are met
* Evaluating learning program effectiveness using Kirkpatrick Levels 1-3 and refining based on feedback
* Supporting engagement delivery through phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation
* Facilitating workshops and presentations using various collaboration tools
* Providing guidance and mentorship to junior team members to enhance their development
* Staying informed on the latest trends in learning and development to contribute to internal initiatives
* Developing and presenting innovative ideas and solutions to clients and stakeholders
* Building and maintaining client relationships to support organizational change management efforts
* Analyzing business operations and ERP solutions to align learning strategies with organizational goals

What You Must Have
  
  

* 4-8 years of prior relevant experience in consulting
* Master’s degree or equivalent qualification in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, Education (M.Ed.), Communications, HR, Organizational Development or Psychology.
* Certification in Instructional Design or Learning Experience Design (e.g., ATD/CPTD, Articulate, or an equivalent recognized ID credential) is required, while PROSCI or other Change Management certifications are preferred and considered an added advantage.
* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 2 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* An interest in upskilling for a digital world and technology trends, an openness to learning new tools and adapting how you work.
* Will to work in a fast-paced environment with sometimes unpredictable circumstances or changes, comfortable working in ambiguity.
* Demonstrating proficiency in AI tools for workforce solutions
* Utilizing analytical thinking to assess training effectiveness
* Collaborating with engagement managers to address client needs
* Exhibiting ability to work independently and in teams
* Supporting client-facing consulting engagements and mentoring juniors
* Leveraging AI-human collaboration for enhanced productivity

description:
At Pepperl+Fuchs, we combine a strong commitment to innovation with a deep respect for the traditions that have shaped our success. From renewable energy and automotive production to water treatment plants and chemical systems, our advanced electronic sensors and automation components enable smooth and safe operations around the globe.
  
  
We Take Pride In Fostering a Supportive And Collaborative Workplace Culture, Where Employees Feel Connected And Valued - Much Like a Close-knit Family. As We Continue To Grow, We Are Excited To Welcome a New Team Member For The Following Position
  
  
Regional RFQ Specialist
  
  
**Job Description: Regional RFQ Specialist – Explosion Protected Electrical Solutions**
**Role Title:**
Regional RFQ Specialist (Asia Support – India, South East Asia, South Korea, Japan, Australia)
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai, Bangalore or Mumbai, India
  
  
**Department:**
Regional Sales Support
  
  
**Reporting To:**
Sales Director APAC
  
  
**Summary Of Role**
We are seeking a highly detail-oriented, commercially minded, and technically proficient Regional RFQ Specialist to join our team at the Chennai Systems Engineering Centre (SEC). In this role, you will act as the dedicated expert on our Solution Engineering Centre capabilities, supporting regional RFQs and preparing technical/commercial proposals for Asia-based sales teams and customers. You will serve as the crucial technical interface between regional sales organizations, engineering, and production—analyzing complex customer specifications, developing competitive cost estimates, and designing hazardous area/explosion-protected electro-mechanical and LV panel solutions to drive regional business growth.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities & Tasks**

* Regional Proposal & RFQ Management (Asia Region)
* Act as the central 2nd level technical support interface for the Asia-wide sales network and regional sales organizations.
* Prepare accurate, competitive, and timely cost estimates, technical proposals, and formal RFQ submissions for explosion-protected electro-mechanical solutions and LV electrical panels.
* Ensure all quotations and RFQs are completed accurately and submitted within agreed timelines and regional KPI targets.
* Technical Analysis & Solution Design
* Review and technically qualify customer specifications, Single Line Diagrams (SLDs), wiring schematics, mechanical drawings, and international standards.
* Select suitable electrical components, switchgear, and enclosure configurations tailored to specific customer/project requirements in explosive gas or dust environments.
* Develop basic general arrangement (GA) drawings, preliminary solution designs, and detailed Bills of Materials (BOMs) for junction boxes, motor starter panels, and LV panel solutions.
* Perform technical feasibility studies and calculations to support customer quotations.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Interface
* Collaborate closely with Regional Sales, Local Engineering, R&D, Product Management, and Production teams to ensure technical and commercial compliance.
* Support regional sales teams in pricing strategies, price-finding situations, and technical query resolution.
* Directly (or via regional sales teams) interact with Asia-based clients to clarify technical requirements and present engineered proposals.

**Role Requirements & Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Education: Bachelor’s Degree, or B.Tech in Electrical or Electro-Mechanical Engineering.
* Experience:
* 5+ years of relevant experience in pre-sales support, electrical panel design, estimation, or costing.
* Prior experience in a 2nd-level technical sales support or pre-sales engineering role for control, instrumentation, or electro-mechanical products is highly preferred.

**Technical Skills & Knowledge**

* Hazardous Area Knowledge: Familiarity with explosion-protected equipment (Ex-d, Ex-e, etc.) and global standards (e.g., IECEx, ATEX) for explosive gas or dust atmospheres.
* Electrical & Mechanical Literacy: Strong ability to read, interpret, and analyze wiring schematics, mechanical drawings, technical specifications, and single-line diagrams (SLDs).
* Product Expertise: Deep understanding of Low Voltage (LV) electrical panels, motor starter panels, switchgear, and junction box configurations.
* Software Proficiency:
* Proficient in Microsoft Office suite (Excel, Word).
* Knowledge of AutoCAD / 2D Electro-CAD tools or ERP systems is a strong advantage.

**Soft Skills & Competencies**

* Communication: Excellent written and spoken English communication skills; comfortable acting as a regional bridge between engineering and international sales offices.
* Commercial Acumen: Ability to balance technical compliance with cost-effective engineering.
* Detail-Oriented & Organized: Proven ability to manage multiple regional queries simultaneously under tight deadlines.

Are you excited about this opportunity? We can’t wait to get to know you! Submit your application online — we’re looking forward to hearing from you!

We welcome applications from all individuals, regardless of ethnicity, country of origin, gender, religion, sexual orientation, age, skin color, physical or mental abilities, social background, or any other protected characteristic. All employment decisions are made based on these principles and in full compliance with applicable federal and state laws.

title: Member
description:
**Company Description**
MeHAN is a human-centered advisory firm focused on closing the gap between buying AI tools and actually using them effectively in organizations. Instead of traditional button-click training, MeHAN addresses the real barriers to AI adoption, such as fear, resistance, leadership gaps, and cultural signals. The company uses diagnostic, data-driven insights tailored to each client’s unique context, avoiding generic best practices. Built specifically for India’s mid-market companies with 100 to 2,000 employees, MeHAN follows a structured four-step process from free pulse checks to custom programs that measurably improve AI adoption. Applicants join a team committed to making AI investments meaningful, practical, and measurable for clients.
  
**Role Description**
As a Member at MeHAN, you will work full time on-site in the Greater Kolkata Area, contributing to diagnostic-led advisory projects that help clients improve AI adoption. You will support the design and delivery of pulse checks and team-wide diagnostics, gather and interpret organizational data, and help translate findings into clear, actionable insights for client teams. You will collaborate with colleagues to shape custom programs that address behavioral, cultural, and leadership barriers to AI usage, and assist in tracking impact and adoption metrics over time. The role involves direct interaction with client stakeholders, participation in workshops and discussions, and ongoing documentation and reporting to ensure clarity, consistency, and measurable outcomes.
  
**Qualifications**

* Ability to understand organizational behavior, culture, and change dynamics, and apply these insights to improve technology adoption.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including experience working with diagnostic data, surveys, or structured assessments.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present findings and recommendations to diverse stakeholder groups.
* Comfort working in client-facing environments, with skills in collaboration, facilitation, and building trust across teams.
* Interest in AI, digital transformation, or technology-enabled change, and willingness to learn about emerging tools and practices.
* Ability to work on-site full time in the Greater Kolkata Area, managing priorities and deadlines in a fast-moving advisory setting.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, psychology, sociology, technology, or a related field is preferred; relevant experience in consulting, HR, L&D, or transformation roles is an advantage.
* Demonstrated integrity, respect for diverse perspectives, and commitment to non-discriminatory, inclusive work practices.

title: Industrial Engineering And Human Resources Consultant
description:
**Company Description**
BoardLine Spotlight is an independent business and industry intelligence platform that tracks leadership movements, boardroom decisions, and corporate strategies shaping Indian industry. Founded in 2026, the organization focuses on decoding how executive choices influence market dynamics across infrastructure, cement and building materials, logistics, and supply chains. Its insights support stakeholders who need clear, data-driven views of strategic shifts within key sectors. Team members collaborate closely with industry experts and decision-makers to deliver timely, relevant analysis that informs business outcomes.

**Role Description**
The Industrial Engineering and Human Resources Consultant will work on-site in Kolkata under a contract engagement. This role involves analyzing operational workflows, resource utilization, and organizational structures to recommend efficiency improvements across targeted business functions. The consultant will evaluate workforce planning, job roles, and HR policies, and will design interventions that align talent strategies with operational goals. Day-to-day responsibilities include conducting interviews and field studies, gathering and interpreting data, preparing detailed reports and presentations, and collaborating with internal teams to implement recommended process and HR changes. The role also requires supporting change management initiatives and providing advisory input on long-term organizational development plans.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess skills in industrial engineering analysis, including process mapping, workflow optimization, and capacity planning.
* Candidates should possess skills in human resources consulting, such as workforce planning, role design, performance management frameworks, and policy review.
* Candidates should possess skills in data collection and analysis, including use of spreadsheets, basic statistical tools, and report-writing for operational and HR insights.
* Candidates should possess skills in stakeholder collaboration, including conducting interviews, facilitating workshops, and communicating recommendations to leadership.
* Relevant qualifications include a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Human Resources, Organizational Psychology, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Experience in consulting, operations management, or HR business partnering within infrastructure, logistics, or manufacturing sectors is highly beneficial.
* Demonstrated ability to work on-site with cross-functional teams, manage multiple projects, and deliver clear, concise documentation and presentations.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and familiarity with change management and organizational development practices.

description:

Manager Business Consulting - IT
  
  
**Kolkata, West Bengal, India | Working Scheme: On-Site | Job Type: Regular / Permanent / Unlimited / FTE | Reference Code: req33939**
It's about Being What's next. What's in it for you?
  
  
The Manager Business Consulting will act as a business-facing IT partner by managing the application lifecycle and providing effective post-implementation support for Sales and Supply processes across the RSE region
  
  
At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. These benefits demonstrate Linde's commitment to creating a positive work experience for its employees.

Linde values diversity and recognizes the importance of fostering inclusion in our work environment. We believe that our success depends on the diverse perspectives of our employees, customers, and global markets. As an employer of choice, we strive to support our employees' growth, welcome new ideas, and respect our differences.
  
  
Team
  
  
Making an impact. What will you do?
  
  

* In this role you will participate as a core project team member in the implementation of SAP and non-SAP applications, including system interfaces, across the RSE region
* Further you will own the application development lifecycle for assigned initiatives by working with business users to gather and document requirements, translating them into SAP process designs, developing the functional specifications, configuring SAP solutions, collaborating closely with ABAP developers for custom developments, performing system testing, supporting user acceptance test and ensuring successful deployment.

* Further you have a minimum of 3 years’ experience in system implementations, particularly in SAP SD
* Furthermore, you have a strong business knowledge and understanding of Sales and Supply processes

Responsible for providing on-site and remote technical support, maintenance, and troubleshooting for uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems, PDU (Power Distribution Units), STS (Static transfer Switches), AHF(Active Harmonic filters) and other similar Power electronics products. Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. As an Experienced Associate - Organizational Change Management you will support client transformation efforts by developing change management strategies, communication plans, stakeholder engagement approaches, and learning solutions that help people adapt to new ways of working within our Workforce Consulting practice. As an Associate you will learn through client engagement, contribute to project tasks, build confidence in a fast-paced environment, and use curiosity, adaptability, and reliability to support senior team members while developing your technical knowledge and personal brand. In this role at PwC, you will help assess change impacts, readiness, and stakeholder needs, create personas and journey maps, identify barriers to adoption, and develop materials that support communication and training efforts across organizational change initiatives.

* Conducting change impact, readiness, and stakeholder assessments to shape engagement plans
* Developing change management strategies, communications, and leadership and end user messaging for transformation initiatives
* Creating personas and journey maps to reflect stakeholder needs across client groups
* Identifying barriers to change and developing mitigation actions to support adoption
* Establishing performance measures to track progress of change initiatives and adoption outcomes
* Designing training needs analyses and learning plans that support implementation activities

title: Application Specialist
description:
**Job Description Summary**
As the Application Specialist for Ultrasound, you will be responsible for driving and executing clinical education training, demonstration management, and demonstration strategies. You will facilitate evidence-based practices and support both the customer experience and commercial teams from pre-sale through post-implementation by delivering effective, outcome-based education and training solutions. Your efforts will directly impact our customers’ ability to enhance productivity, improve patient care, and elevate quality by optimizing their technical and clinical competencies, image quality, workflow, and protocol management.
  
  
GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Provide technical and clinical leadership during the sales process by demonstrating the full range of Ultrasound products, including potential uses, product capabilities, and customer benefits.
* Coordinate, schedule, and execute objective-based system training for customers and channel partners; monitor and report on training outcomes.
* Develop and deliver product training to customers on equipment usage.
* Monitor customer installations of ultrasound products within the assigned territory/region to enhance customer satisfaction and maintain strong relationships.
* Support trade shows and professional conferences by conducting product demonstrations and customer training sessions.
* Leverage market and product knowledge to assist the sales team in developing effective sales, marketing, and customer service strategies.
* Build and maintain relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) in the region; responsible for training the sales and dealer teams periodically to enhance their capabilities.
* Penetrate competitive accounts and provide current market intelligence to the business.
* Promote new product features (NPI) and clinical techniques; collaborate with customers to develop training plans and strategies that support new product adoption and ongoing training needs in Ultrasound.
* Serve as the focal point for the modality/team by identifying customer satisfaction issues, assisting with escalations, resolving problems, and addressing specialty training requests.
* Advocate for and support the adoption of hybrid training delivery models for customers.
* Maintain well-documented pre- and post-training records in alignment with global guidelines.
* Responsible for pre- and post-sales support of ultrasound systems. Responsibilities include conducting clinical activities such as workshops, CMEs, webinars, and hands-on training.
* The incumbent will be based as per requirement and will support the LCT (Local Customer Team) or the Region depending on the scope of priority.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree/ Diploma with 5+ years of experience in MNC as Ultrasound applications is required.
* Experience in Fetal Medicine, General Imaging, OB/GYN, Vascular Sonography, and Cardiology applications is essential
* Ultrasound technical/clinical industry experience is required, along with any applicable certifications.
* Good knowledge of 2D, Doppler, and color flow imaging, with experience in 3D and 4D imaging (especially for OB/GYN).
* Must be willing to travel up to 75%, both within and outside the assigned geographic region.

**Desired Characteristics**

* Excellent interpersonal, oral and written communication skills.
* Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs

title: Tender And Bid Management Intern
description:
**Company Description**
QuillAir Pvt. Ltd. is an aerial innovation company focused on AI-powered, sustainable drones for agriculture, defense, mapping, and urban mobility. The company designs and manufactures advanced drone systems, offers Drone-as-a-Service (DaaS), and provides training, integration, and data solutions to clients. By combining AI, automation, and precision engineering, QuillAir delivers reliable aerial platforms tailored for industrial and governmental use. The organization is driven by a mission to innovate the sky while empowering the earth through practical, high-impact drone applications.
  
**Role Description**
The Tender and Bid Management Intern is a full-time, on-site role based in Kolkata. This role involves supporting the end-to-end tender and bid process, including identifying relevant opportunities, gathering documentation, and coordinating submissions. The intern will help prepare bid proposals, draft and review technical and commercial content, and maintain tender databases and trackers. Day-to-day responsibilities include collaborating with cross-functional teams for inputs, ensuring timely submission of bids, and assisting in post-bid follow-ups and documentation compliance. The role also includes researching market and competitive information to strengthen future proposals.
  
**Qualifications**

* Knowledge of bid processes and tender management, with the ability to understand tender requirements and compliance needs.
* Skills in bid preparation and proposal writing, including organizing information, drafting structured responses, and basic documentation review.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, to coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders.
* Attention to detail, analytical mindset, and capability to work with deadlines and multiple bids simultaneously.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and comfort with online tender portals and documentation tools.
* Pursuing or having completed a degree in Business, Engineering, Management, or a related field; prior exposure to tenders or sales support is an advantage.
* Interest in drones, aerospace, or technology sectors, and willingness to learn about technical and commercial aspects of the business.

title: Intern Assistant
description:
**Company Description**
Research Ramp is a specialized publication support organization that helps researchers, PhD scholars, universities, and research institutions successfully publish in internationally indexed journals such as Scopus, Web of Science (WoS), SCI, and SSCI. The team provides end-to-end support including journal selection, manuscript and scientific editing, publication strategy, peer review guidance, formatting, plagiarism guidance, and predatory journal detection. Acting as strategic publication partners rather than generic service providers, Research Ramp focuses on improving manuscript quality and guiding researchers confidently through the publication process. Backed by a panel of over 1,200 PhD-qualified editors, the company supports diverse disciplines across engineering, medical sciences, computer science, life sciences, management, business, humanities, social sciences, and multidisciplinary research. Research Ramp operates with a strong commitment to ethical publishing, confidentiality, and research integrity and is trusted by clients across India and multiple countries in Asia and the Gulf region.

**Role Description**
The Intern Assistant role at Research Ramp is an on-site internship based in Kolkata. The intern will support day-to-day operations by assisting with documentation, data entry, and coordination related to publication projects. Typical tasks include organizing research materials, preparing basic reports, updating project trackers, and communicating with internal team members to follow up on timelines and requirements. The intern may also help with preliminary journal research, proofreading simple documents, and maintaining records in digital tools or spreadsheets. This role offers exposure to academic publishing workflows and requires a professional, detail-oriented approach to administrative and coordination tasks.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to handle multiple tasks and maintain accurate records.
* Candidates should possess basic research and documentation skills, including the ability to search for information online and summarize findings clearly.
* Candidates should possess good written and verbal communication skills in English for internal coordination and simple professional correspondence.
* Candidates should possess computer literacy, including familiarity with office productivity tools (e.g., word processing, spreadsheets, presentation software) and basic internet research.
* Candidates should possess attention to detail and a careful, methodical approach to data entry, proofreading, and formatting tasks.
* Beneficial qualifications include ongoing or completed undergraduate studies in fields such as English, Communications, Management, or any discipline with exposure to academic work.
* Additional beneficial qualities include a willingness to learn about academic publishing, ethical research practices, and the ability to work collaboratively in an office environment in Kolkata.
* Stipend - 8-0k INR / Month

title: Manager — Business Growth & Tender Management
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly organised, business-oriented professional to serve as a direct extension of the Founders and Sales Leadership team. This role combines strategic pre-sales support, business operations, cross-functional coordination, and end-to-end government and institutional tender management — making it a uniquely broad role suited for someone with strong execution orientation, commercial instincts, and experience navigating e-procurement ecosystems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Pre-Sales & Business Development Support
* Support Founders and Sales Leaders throughout the full sales lifecycle
* Coordinate customer presentations, technical proposals, RFP/RFQ responses, concept notes, and solution documents
* Work with Engineering, Product, and Delivery teams to gather technical inputs for proposals
* Maintain proposal repositories and sales collateral
* Coordinate customer demonstrations, PoCs, and strategic meetings
* Conduct market, customer, and competitor research
* Track strategic opportunities and follow-ups until closure
* Tender Management & e-Procurement
* Identify, track, and evaluate relevant government and institutional tenders across e-procurement portals — GeM, CPP Procurement Portal, MSTC, state portals (e-Tender WB, APTS, KTPP, eProcure, etc.)
* Manage end-to-end tender lifecycle: sourcing → eligibility analysis → document preparation → submission → follow-up → bid opening → post-tender correspondence
* Read and interpret tender documents including scope of work, technical specifications, EMD/SD requirements, eligibility criteria, and commercial terms
* Coordinate with Finance for EMD / Bank Guarantee / SD arrangements and ensure timely submission
* Prepare and compile all required documents for tender submission — technical bid, price bid, company credentials, certifications, and compliance statements
* Maintain and update tender tracking registers (ongoing, submitted, awarded, lost) with status and follow-up actions
* Monitor e-procurement portal portals and client websites for relevant tender notices — IoT, CAAQMS, environmental monitoring, smart infrastructure, IIoT sectors
* Liaise with government departments, PSUs, and institutional clients for tender clarifications, corrigendum updates, and bid openings
* Maintain login credentials, DSC (Digital Signature Certificate) renewals, portal registrations, and vendor empanelments
* Coordinate with technical and legal teams to ensure all responses to pre-qualification questionnaires and technical queries are accurate and submitted on time
* Analyse lost tenders for lessons learned and support improvement of future bid strategies
* Maintain a repository of standard tender documents, pre-qualified certifications, and company credentials ready for rapid deployment
* Customer & Sales Operations
* Coordinate customer communications, documentation, and project discussions
* Support contract review by highlighting commercial, technical, and operational aspects
* Maintain CRM, opportunity trackers, and sales dashboards
* Coordinate seamless handover from Sales to Delivery
* Cross-Functional Program Management
* Drive execution across strategic initiatives
* Track deliverables, dependencies, and timelines
* Identify bottlenecks and escalate proactively
* Continuously improve internal coordination processes

**Requirements**

* Good hands-on experience working with Government clients
* Hands-on experience in bidding and government bidding portal/site management
* Experience in preparing deal collateral
* Notice Period: Immediate or shorter notice period preferred
* Language Skills: Bengali fluency is essential; must be fluent in English with strong vocal command for presentations

**Preferred Qualifications**

* B.E. / B.Tech with MBA — Mandatory

title: Consultant - TTC - Oracle GTM Techno - Hyderabad/Bengaluru/Mumbai/Pune/Gurugram/Chennai/Kolkata
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Tax Consultant II**
Join Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited and help clients improve cross-border trade operations through Oracle Global Trade Management (GTM) solutions. This role focuses on translating global trade compliance, logistics, and business requirements into scalable Oracle GTM configurations, workflows, and integrations. You will support compliant and efficient trade processes across areas such as screening, classification, licensing, duty and tax determination, documentation, and reporting. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of technology, compliance, and process transformation in a global environment.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Tax Consultant II on the Oracle Global Trade Management (GTM) team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Lead workshops, document trade processes, define business rules, and create functional specifications, user stories, process maps, test scenarios, and traceability artifacts.
* Configure Oracle GTM objects, business rules, workflows, approvals, notifications, exception handling, role-based access, and audit requirements.
* Design and validate integrations between Oracle GTM and enterprise systems, support data mappings and governance, and assist with data conversion and migration activities.
* Plan and execute system integration testing, user acceptance testing, compliance scenario testing, defect resolution, cutover support, and hypercare activities.
* Develop standard operating procedures, training materials, compliance reporting outputs, and audit support documentation for operational and compliance teams.

**The team**
Deloitte’s Oracle and trade transformation teams help organizations improve the way they manage global trade compliance, customs readiness, and cross-border operations through technology-enabled solutions. The team works across business, compliance, and technology stakeholders to design and implement scalable processes that support accuracy, control, and operational efficiency. Professionals in this area support complex transformation programs involving enterprise systems, data, and regulatory requirements across multiple jurisdictions.
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru, Chennai, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Pune**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 2-4 years of hands-on experience implementing or supporting Oracle Global Trade Management (GTM) in a functional or techno-functional capacity.
* Experience with restricted party screening, sanctions or embargo compliance, import or export compliance, export controls, Harmonized System or Harmonized Tariff Schedule classification, country of origin, valuation concepts, licensing controls, or free trade agreement and preference concepts.
* Experience translating compliance policy into system-enforceable rules and workflows.
* Experience documenting business requirements, functional requirements, user stories, process diagrams, and test scripts.
* Experience with APIs, flat files, middleware, data mapping, or error handling for system integrations.
* Knowledge of cross-border trade process flows across order, ship, invoice, customs, logistics, and returns.
* Experience with data analysis, reconciliation, and defect triage.

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud or similar middleware platforms.
* Familiarity with Oracle ecosystem integrations, including enterprise resource planning or supply chain systems.
* Experience with multi-country or global trade programs and complex organizational structures.
* Experience with broker or filing provider integrations.
* Experience modernizing trade compliance operating models and master data governance.
* Prior consulting delivery experience, including estimation, RAID logs, status reporting, or client leadership.

Join EY and help build a better working world.

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centres. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service focuses on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery, and IT Global Infrastructure services are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for a skilled Senior Regulatory Reporting Professional to support the delivery of technology-enabled regulatory reporting services for digital asset clients. The role focuses on end-to-end report production, data validation, reconciliations, controls, issue management, and regulatory change across U.S. and global reporting obligations. This position offers the opportunity to work closely with clients, onshore teams, technology teams, and operations stakeholders to strengthen reporting accuracy, improve governance, support automation, and build scalable processes aligned with evolving products, entities, and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Regulatory Production & Submissions: Lead regulatory reporting workstreams, including end-to-end preparation, review, and timely submission of U.S. and global filings such as MTL reporting, transaction reporting, financial condition reporting, and capital calculations.
* Broader Banking Regulatory Reporting Exposure: Apply relevant exposure to banking regulatory returns, including capital adequacy, liquidity reporting, ICAAP reporting, balance sheet reporting, and regulatory disclosures, where applicable to the client’s operating model.
* Regulatory Change, Awareness & Reporting Logic: Monitor relevant regulatory developments, interpret reporting instructions, assess data and process impacts, and coordinate timely updates to reporting logic, templates, procedures, controls, and technology workflows.
* Data Sourcing & Analytical Reviews: Perform complex data extraction, validation, variance analysis, and root-cause exception investigations across large datasets to ensure data completeness and integrity.
* Control Governance & Audit Readiness: Embed rigorous quality controls—including maker-checker reviews, clear audit trails, evidence retention, and sign-off protocols—across all reporting cycles.
* Automation & Process Improvement: Identify reporting process inefficiencies and support automation initiatives using tools such as SQL, Python, and modern data platforms to reduce manual effort and operational risk.
* Analytics & Responsible AI Awareness: Apply awareness of responsible AI and analytics use cases to support anomaly detection, exception analysis, reporting commentary, and workflow monitoring.
* Team Leadership & Stakeholder Alignment: Provide technical coaching and review support to junior team members while coordinating seamlessly across cross-functional partners and U.S.-based stakeholders.
* Time-Zone Flexibility: Willingness to operate during late/extended hours to ensure seamless hand-offs with U.S.-based stakeholders and meet strict global submission deadlines.
* Al fluency - Demonstrates broad knowledge of AI trends, opportunities, and risks within operations. Supports the implementation of AI driven process improvements, encourages responsible AI adoption within the team, and contributes to efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* 4–6 years of relevant experience, including 2–3 years in a senior role within regulatory reporting or financial services.
* Hands-on experience with U.S. regulatory filings, financial condition reporting, customer liability reporting, permissible investments, transaction reporting, and Money Transmitter License (MTL) submissions.
* Hands-on experience in FFIEC 031 , FRY 9C , FRY 15 , FFIEC 041/051 , FR 2062a , Basel & Liquidity reporting , COREP/FINREP , Money Transmission reporting .
* Master’s degree in accounting, finance, business, or a related field is preferred; CA, CPA, CFA, MBA, or an equivalent professional qualification would be an advantage.
* Strong end-to-end understanding of regulatory reporting production cycles, data validation, reconciliations, variance analysis, workpaper preparation, and review controls.
* Solid working knowledge of financial statement analysis, regulatory capital concepts, ICAAP reporting, and applicable regulatory compliance frameworks.
* Exposure to banking regulatory reporting frameworks, including capital adequacy, ICAAP reporting, liquidity risk reporting, balance sheet schedules, and regulatory disclosures, would be beneficial.
* Proven ability to translate complex regulatory mandates into business requirements.
* Knowledge of reporting platforms and data tools, along with hands-on experience in SQL, Python, Snowflake, or Looker, would be an added advantage.
* Awareness of Generative AI tools and workflow automation to support data extraction, exception analysis, and reporting efficiency would be an advantage.
* Strong control mindset, including practical experience with maker-checker reviews, robust audit trails, evidence retention, issue management, and key risk/control testing.
* Advanced data analytics skills, with the ability to query large datasets, perform root-cause analysis on exceptions, and communicate structured findings clearly.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of effectively managing relationships across onshore/offshore teams, product managers, engineers, and executive stakeholders.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, demonstrating strong ownership, continuous improvement, and agility in adapting to evolving regulatory landscapes.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint is required. U.S. visa readiness or international travel willingness is preferred but not mandatory.

**< What we look for>>**
We are looking for a professional with strong Reporting knowledge, excellent analytical & communication skills. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, demonstrates ownership and consistently delivers high quality work while meeting deadlines
  
  
What we offer you
  
  
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.

In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, and a sense of belonging is fostered. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.

title: Field Application Specialist
company: DSS Takara Bio India Pvt Ltd
description:
**About the Company:**

DSS Takara Bio India is a joint venture between DSS Imagetech Pvt. Ltd. and Takara Bio Inc. established in 2011 to bring world-class quality molecular biology tools and research kits to the doorstep of the Indian scientific community, making them readily available and affordable in the Indian biotechnology market.

We market Takara Bio, Clontech, Cellartis, and Rubicon products to customers throughout the country. Additionally, we represent comprehensive product lines from our Partnered brands Macherey-Nagel, TriLink and PromoCell. At present, we are manufacturing Takara Bio branded routine molecular biology products in India at our manufacturing unit located in New Delhi.

**Job Description:**

**Primary Role**
: The Field Application Specialist is responsible for providing technical support to end-users by identifying, researching, and resolving product-related issues. This role includes conducting operational and technical training for clients and working closely with Sales, Marketing, and Key Account Management to ensure customer needs are met. Additionally, the specialist offers technical support to both internal and external customers who use or assist in the use of Takara Bio’s products.

**Objective:**
To provide reliable, quick and efficient support to customers and sales members in the region.

**Responsibilities:**

* Pre-sales: Assist sales team members with technical queries during pre-sales discussions
* Post-sales: Troubleshooting: guidance to customers for running their experiments or having technical queries
* Provide quick and accurate resolution to query/complaints
* Provide training to dealers and sales teams as required and identified
* Participate in conferences and roadshows when conducted
* Takes an active role in ensuring that any escalation is handled promptly and effectively
* Be a reference point for the entire regional team on various application topics and is able to resolve most of the items escalated

**KPI:**

* Make routine visits to customers and dealers and generate leads for business development
* Update competitor activity/promotions to PM as monthly plan
* Capture the initial complaint in CRM within stipulated TAT
* Gather necessary details as quickly as possible to identify the root cause.
* Ensure timely closure and resolution of complaints.

**Job Specification:**

**Candidate must have:**

* Enthusiasm for the Life Sciences Research Field
* Customer Focus Approach
* Action-oriented and good decision-making ability
* Team Player & Good Communication Skills—Verbal & written
* Continuous and Versatile Learner
* Good customer service attitude and willingness to travel extensively

**Qualification**

* M.SC / M. Tech.- Biotechnology/Life Sciences

4–8 years of experience in technologies such as cell and gene therapy, next-generation sequencing, viral transduction, molecular biology techniques, and protein research.

title: Tendering Specialist
description:
**Company Description** 
 Nu Calcutta Construction Company (NCCC), founded in 1993, is an Indian\-origin firm headquartered in Kolkata and recognized as a market leader in industrial lining works, including refractory, insulation, chimney/borosilicate lining, fireproofing, and AR lining. The company’s strength lies in its long\-tenured employees and workforces deployed across India, reflecting a strong culture of commitment and expertise. NCCC is led by its founding partners, who collectively bring decades of experience from leading global and national institutions and industries. With a blend of seasoned leadership and next\-generation management talent, the firm is focused on sustainable, exponential growth in the industrial sector. NCCC offers team members the opportunity to contribute to complex, large\-scale industrial projects within a growing, family\-oriented organization.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Tendering Specialist is a full\-time, on\-site role based in the Kolkata metropolitan area. The role involves managing the end\-to\-end tendering process, including identifying relevant tenders, reviewing tender documents, preparing proposals, and ensuring timely submission in line with client and regulatory requirements. The Tendering Specialist will collaborate with engineering, procurement, finance, and leadership teams to gather technical and commercial inputs, clarify tender queries, and develop competitive bids. Daily responsibilities include analyzing tender specifications, estimating costs, coordinating supplier quotations, maintaining tender documentation, and tracking tender outcomes for continuous improvement. The role also requires maintaining updated knowledge of market conditions, client requirements, and industry standards to help the company win projects in industrial lining and related services.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong tender management and procurement skills, including experience in end\-to\-end bid preparation, vendor coordination, and compliance with tender requirements.
* Excellent analytical skills to review technical and commercial tender documents, estimate costs, and evaluate risks and competitiveness.
* Effective communication and proposal writing skills to prepare clear, accurate, and persuasive technical and commercial submissions.
* Relevant experience in construction, industrial services, engineering, or related sectors; familiarity with industrial lining or similar works is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, commerce, or a related discipline; advanced qualifications in project management or procurement are beneficial.
* Proficiency in MS Office (especially Excel and Word) and comfort working with tender portals and documentation management systems.
* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to work under time\-sensitive tender deadlines.
* Ability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams on\-site in the Kolkata metropolitan area and maintain professional relationships with clients and vendors.

* Excellent organizational and time\-management skills, with attention to detail and accuracy in paperwork and compliance.
